Send over your Resume along with a link to your Portfolio / Demo Reel.

title: AI Content Editor / ComfyUI & LoRA Specialist — Remote
description:
We are looking for a hands-on AI Content Editor who can create highly realistic, consistent photo content using ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion / Flux and custom LoRA workflows.



This is not a basic Canva, Midjourney or generic video-editing role. We need someone who can build and run reliable image-generation workflows for realistic creator-style content, keep a person’s identity consistent across many images, and deliver organised, repeatable outputs.



What you will do



* Create realistic photo sets for different creator profiles: selfies, lifestyle, indoor, outdoor, gym, mirror, travel and social-media-style content

* Train and test custom LoRA models from approved image datasets

* Use ComfyUI and suitable models such as Flux, SDXL or newer image models to generate natural-looking, consistent images

* Maintain face, body, hair, skin texture and overall identity consistency across different outfits, poses, locations and lighting

* Fix common AI issues: distorted hands, faces, anatomy, clothing, backgrounds, text and overly artificial-looking skin

* Build reusable ComfyUI workflows, prompt templates and organised folders so the team can reproduce strong results

* Create batches efficiently while keeping quality control high

* Occasionally support image-to-video or short-form AI video workflows when needed



Required experience



* Real hands-on experience with **ComfyUI**

* Experience using and ideally training **custom LoRA models**

* Strong understanding of realistic AI image generation, identity consistency, prompting, inpainting, upscaling and detail correction

* Experience with Stable Diffusion, Flux, SDXL, RunPod, AI Toolkit, Kohya_ss, CivitAI or similar tools

* Good visual taste: you can clearly recognise when an image looks fake, over-smoothed or inconsistent

* Strong English and reliable communication

* Ability to follow a content brief, work independently and deliver work on time



Nice to have



* Experience creating realistic UGC, social-media or creator-style photo content

* Experience with image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo, Wan, Higgsfield or Runway

* Experience creating content in fast-moving online businesses, agencies, performance marketing or the creator economy

* Experience working with sensitive client assets professionally and confidentially



Important



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to writing prompts in ChatGPT, making simple Midjourney images or editing standard videos. We are specifically looking for someone who understands technical AI image workflows and can create consistent, photorealistic results at scale.



Compensation



* Remote, long-term contractor role

* Flexible part-time or full-time scope depending on quality and availability

* $800–$2,000 per month, depending on real skill level, speed, availability and test results

* We can start with a paid practical test for the right candidate



To apply



Please complete the application form in English and include:



* Your main AI tools and workflow

* Whether you have trained LoRAs yourself or only used existing ones

* Examples or portfolio links showing realistic, consistent AI characters or image sets

* Your expected monthly compensation and availability

title: E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist
description:
Full-Time Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | Australian E-Commerce Brand



We are an Australian fashion/e-commerce business looking for an experienced E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist to join us full-time remotely.



This is NOT a social media manager role.



We are not looking for someone to simply create Instagram posts, write captions or maintain a content calendar.



We are looking for someone who understands the technical backend of an e-commerce business and can take ownership of our digital ecosystem — Shopify, Google, Meta, tracking, analytics, SEO, advertising infrastructure and performance.



Initially, this will be a hands-on audit, repair and optimisation project. Once the foundations are working correctly, the role will evolve into ongoing digital growth and campaign management.



THE INITIAL PROJECT



Your first responsibility will be to thoroughly review our existing digital setup.



We want you to find what is working, what isn't working, what has been configured incorrectly, what is missing and what can be improved.



This includes reviewing and working directly with:



Shopify — store configuration, apps, integrations, technical issues, site structure and performance



Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — tracking, events, conversions, attribution and reporting



Google Tag Manager



Google Search Console



Google Merchant Center and product feeds



Google Ads — account structure, conversion tracking, audiences and campaign infrastructure



Meta Business Suite / Business Manager



Meta Ads Manager



Meta Pixel and Conversion API


 and Instagram account integration



Shopify/Meta/Instagram catalogue and commerce integrations



Domain verification and associated Meta assets



SEO — technical SEO, on-page SEO, indexing, metadata, site structure, schema and organic search opportunities



Website speed and technical performance



Conversion tracking and attribution



E-commerce analytics and reporting



We don't just want reports telling us there is a problem.  We want someone capable of actually fixing the problems.



THEN WE WANT TO GROW



Once the digital foundations are correct, your role will progressively move into performance and growth.



You should be comfortable looking at real business data and understanding what it means.



That includes metrics such as:



Traffic | Conversion Rate | ROAS | CAC | CPA | CTR | CPC | AOV | Revenue | Customer Acquisition | Returning Customers | Funnel Performance | Organic Traffic | Search Rankings



More importantly, you need to understand what levers to pull when those numbers aren't where they should be.



We want someone who can investigate why performance is changing and then take action.



That could mean improving SEO, restructuring a campaign, correcting tracking, improving a landing page, changing audiences, fixing a product feed, improving site structure or identifying another problem within the customer journey.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have genuine hands-on experience with several of the following:



Shopify / GA4 / Google Tag Manager / Search Console / Merchant Center / Google Ads / Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads Manager / Meta Pixel / Conversion API / Instagram integration / Technical SEO / E-commerce Analytics / CRO



You don't necessarily need to be the world's leading expert in every platform.



But you do need to understand how these systems connect and work together.



We are looking for someone who:



Is technically strong and enjoys solving problems



Can work independently and take ownership



Understands e-commerce and digital performance



Is highly analytical



Can interpret data rather than simply produce reports



Can identify problems and recommend solutions

description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Insurance Billing Team Lead to oversee our insurance billing operations and support a team responsible for managing the complete insurance claim lifecycle. This role requires a strong understanding of insurance billing processes, excellent follow-up skills, and the ability to lead, train, and support a team while ensuring claims are accurately managed from initial submission through final processing and payment resolution.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with insurance claim follow-up, a strong background in dental or healthcare billing, and the ability to oversee daily workflows, provide guidance to team members, and ensure department goals are consistently met.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee and support the insurance billing team, including monitoring workflows, assigning priorities, and ensuring timely completion of claim follow-up activities.

Provide leadership, guidance, and coaching to team members to improve accuracy, efficiency, and overall performance.

Manage the full insurance claim lifecycle, from initial claim submission through final adjudication and payment resolution.

Follow up with insurance companies regarding outstanding, delayed, denied, or pending claims.

Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and insurance responses to determine appropriate next steps.

Identify claim discrepancies, missing information, coding issues, and documentation requirements.

Work directly with insurance carriers to obtain claim status updates and resolve payment delays.

Monitor claim aging reports and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding claims.

Assist with submitting corrected claims, appeals, and additional documentation when necessary.

Ensure insurance payments are posted accurately and unresolved balances are properly addressed.

Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase collections, and enhance overall billing efficiency.

Leadership Responsibilities

Supervise and support insurance billing staff to ensure department expectations are met.

Conduct regular reviews of team productivity, claim follow-up activity, and outstanding insurance balances.

Train new team members on insurance billing procedures, systems, and best practices.

Serve as a resource for team members when complex insurance issues arise.

Promote accountability, organization, and consistent follow-through within the department.

Qualifications

Previous experience in dental insurance billing, healthcare revenue cycle management, or a related field required.

Prior experience leading, supervising, or mentoring a billing team strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of dental insurance processes, claim submission requirements, and insurance terminology.

Proven ability to manage claims from submission through completion with consistent follow-up.

Experience handling denied claims, appeals, insurance correspondence, and claim resolution.

Excellent spoken and written English communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and effectively with insurance representatives, patients, and internal team members.

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple accounts and deadlines.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to research and resolve complex billing issues.

Ability to work independently while also providing leadership and support to a team.

Experience with dental billing software, electronic claim systems, and insurance portals preferred.



We are a growing company that currently has about 40 people working on our team in the Philippines. In order to know that you read the full message, can you please start your reply message with the word "sunshine".



The ideal candidate is a proactive leader who understands that successful insurance billing requires ownership, organization, and consistent follow-through. This individual should be comfortable managing their own workload while also overseeing a team, identifying areas for improvement, supporting staff development, and ensuring insurance claims continue moving forward until they are fully processed and resolved.

Because this position requires frequent communication with insurance carriers, the ideal candidate must possess excellent spoken and written English communication skills and be able to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently during phone conversations and written correspondence. Strong communication is essential for building productive relationships with insurance representatives and efficiently resolving claim issues.
salary: $5 per hour with room to grow

title: Asset and Commercial Finance & Loan Administrator
description:
We are looking for an Asset and Commercial Finance and Loan Administrator. This is an Australian finance and mortgage broking business, writing asset, commercial and home loans for self-employed and business clients. As deal volume grows, we need a dedicated loan administrator to keep files moving so the brokers can focus on writing and settling loans.



Important note on the role scope: this position primarily supports asset and commercial finance, not mortgage/home loan processing. Commercial finance here means lines of credit, overdrafts, and unsecured/secured commercial lending — not property/mortgage deals. Asset finance covers equipment lending. Candidates with only mortgage/home loan processing experience are still welcome to apply, but should be prepared to speak to how their skills transfer.



About the Role

You'll also liaise with clients after onboarding to keep them updated, and maintain clean, accurate records in the CRM.



This role suits someone organized and detail-focused who understands loan processing and can keep a busy pipeline moving. Starting at approximately 20 hours per week, with scope to increase to full-time as deal volume grows.



Key Responsibilities

Loan & Deal Administration

Load new deals into lender portals accurately and on time

Prepare, check and package loan application documents

Track deals through assessment, approval and settlement

Information & Document Gathering



Chase outstanding information and documents from clients and third parties

Follow up lenders, referrers and clients to keep files moving

Keep files complete, compliant and audit-ready

Client Coordination

Coordinate with brokers and support staff on next steps

Respond to queries promptly and professionally

CRM & Process



Maintain accurate records and deal statuses in GoHighLevel and Smartsheet

Keep pipelines current so nothing slips through the cracks

Build simple SOPs for recurring admin tasks

Skills & Experience



Experience in loan processing, mortgage or finance administration

Familiarity with lender portals and loan application documents

Strong attention to detail and a compliance mindset

Comfortable following up clients and third parties to gather information

CRM experience (GoHighLevel and Smartsheet a plus) and confident with Microsoft Teams

title: Media Buyer (Lead Generation | Performance-Focused)
description:
This role is posted by TRES on behalf of Restive Collective, one of the agencies we support. You’ll be hired by and work directly with the Restive Collective team.



About Restive Collective

Restive Collective is a Singapore-based agency that uses personal branding for lead generation. We work with founder-led, service-based businesses — coaches, consultants, gym owners and other experts — and turn their real stories into short-form video and carousel content that brings in qualified leads, not just views.



Our funnels are deliberately simple and proven: short-form video content → Meta ads → lead form or WhatsApp automation / landing page → booked conversation. Every client is spending real money every month, and your job is to make that money work.



Why This Role Is Different

This is not a branding or “boost post” role.



You’ll be working on:

Real lead-generation campaigns for real founders

Ad accounts with live monthly spend, reported and optimised daily

A tight, repeatable funnel where your decisions directly change lead volume and cost per lead

You’ll follow clear SOPs — and you’ll also be trusted to make judgment calls when the numbers call for it.

If you want to become a senior buyer who owns performance end-to-end, this role will stretch you in the right way.



What You’ll Do

Run and optimise conversion-focused Meta campaigns 
 & Instagram) across our client portfolio

Follow the daily media-buying routine: morning — check numbers, queue new ads, log and report; afternoon — optimise, analyse what’s working, recommend next moves

Own campaign health — monitor performance, flag issues early and escalate opportunities to the founder

Set up new client ad accounts (one-time setup per client) and launch new creative batches as they come from our script and video team

Support simple funnel setup where needed — landing page, VSL page and WhatsApp automation (we have a ready framework; no complex builds)

Participate in occasional weekend number-reporting for urgent, higher-spend campaigns (numbers only, with advance heads-up — not full optimisation)

You’ll receive priorities and inputs directly from the founder and account manager — no stakeholder chaos. Our VA handles the admin so you can stay on performance.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For

Writing scripts or designing creatives (we have a scriptwriter, video editor and carousel designer)

Client communication or account management

Redesigning offers or pricing

Juggling 50–100 accounts — we are a high-value, low-volume agency and will add buyers before overloading you

Your focus is campaign performance and health, with clear boundaries and structure.

Who This Role Is For

This role is a good fit if you:

Have hands-on experience running conversion ads (leads or sales) on Meta — not branding or awareness

Think in cost per lead, CPC, CTR and ROAS, and can explain why you scale, pause or kill an ad

Stay calm, analytical and accountable when things move fast

Respect structure but don’t freeze when conditions change

Communicate clearly, report proactively and take ownership seriously

Are ready to commit full-time to one team and grow with it



Who This Role Is NOT For

“Set-and-forget” ad managers who report once a week

Freelancers juggling multiple clients or running their own agency on the side

People who only want to run brand awareness or big-budget branding campaigns

Anyone uncomfortable with responsibility tied to real client spend



How We Work

At Restive Collective, you are judged on results delivered, not hours clocked.

Results-driven \u2014 what matters is your campaigns\u2019 numbers \u2014 cost per lead, lead volume and campaign health \u2014 and how proactively you report and act on them

Systems-led \u2014 clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA so you can focus on your actual craft

Small, focused team \u2014 you work directly with the founder, not through layers of management



Compensation & Growth

SGD 800 – 1,200 / month, depending on experience

Clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA supporting you so you can focus on performance

A growth path to Senior Media Buyer — as we add clients you’ll mentor the next buyer, help build our media-buying SOPs and shape how the agency scales

Exposure to funnels, WhatsApp automation and landing pages — grow beyond ads into full-funnel thinking

If you’re looking for a comfortable, low-pressure role, this isn’t it.

If you’re looking to own performance and grow with a young agency, you’ll thrive here.



How to Apply

Please complete the application form carefully. The questions are designed to understand how you think, not just what tools you’ve used.



👉 Apply here: 
  



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.







Final Note

We’re not looking for button-pushers.

We’re looking for a media buyer who:

Respects structure

Protects campaign performance

Takes ownership seriously

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you

title: Technical GHL & Client Success Specialist (Future Operations Manager)
description:
Company: Automated Service Company

Location: Remote (Agency based in New York Region, USA)

Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: $5.00 – $8.00 / hour + Guaranteed Pay Increases + Guaranteed Performance Bonuses + Health Allowance + PTO

________________________________________

About Us & Career Growth Path



We are a fast-growing automation agency based in the New York Region, USA. We build and integrate 24/7 AI Voice Receptionists, After-Hours Phone Dispatchers, and Automated SMS Booking Setters for local home service companies (plumbers, roofers, HVAC contractors).

We are expanding our core tech stack to GoHighLevel (GHL) to run our entire fulfillment operation. We are looking for a highly motivated, technically elite GHL & Client Success Specialist to join our team immediately on a full-time basis.

Future Operations Manager Path: This is a long-term position with massive growth potential. You will work directly with the founder to manage our clients and systems. As our agency scales past 15-20 clients, this role is designed to move quickly into the Operations Manager position, where you will eventually lead, hire, and manage a team of 2 additional virtual assistants using the systems you help document.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities



Operations & Documentation (SOP Management)

• SOP Creation: Document, create, and refine clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for client configurations, tech setups, and daily maintenance routines.

• Organization & Filing: Label, categorize, and file all company SOPs in a centralized knowledge base (e.g., Notion, Google Drive, or ClickUp) to ensure the business is structured for easy team training.



Client Support & Onboarding (Phone &
)

• Client Success & Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for clients via phone and
 to handle onboarding, account inquiries, and technical support requests.

• Requirements Gathering: Consult directly with clients to map out their specific business workflows, scheduling needs, and CRM service requirements.



GoHighLevel Account Setup & Tech Fulfillment

• Sub-Account Configuration: Set up and manage client sub-accounts inside GHL, including loading snapshots, configuring business profiles, custom fields, calendars, and pipelines.

• Telephony & A2P Configuration: Configure and troubleshoot LC Phone/SMS settings, phone numbers, dedicated
 subdomains, and strict A2P compliance.

• Missed-Call Text-Back: Build and test immediate SMS auto-replies in GHL to capture inbound leads when clients miss a phone call.

• Reputation Management: Set up automated Google Review request workflows via SMS and
 triggered after successful service delivery.

• WiFi Client Capture: Integrate GHL forms and workflows with local business WiFi hardware to automatically capture lead data (names,
s, phones) when customers log in.

• AI & Workflow Integration: Build automated workflows in 
 and GHL to connect text-based AI booking agents and conversational Voice AI systems into client tools (Google Calendar, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro).

• Voice AI System Configuration: Configure, train, and test conversational Voice AI phone agents inside GHL, managing advanced phone routing, call-transfer logic, and missed-call text-back triggers.



Lead Generation Support

• Lead Scraping: Use tools like Lead Scrape or manual research to scrape local business data from Google Maps to fuel our cold outreach.

• Database Management: Keep lead databases perfectly organized in Google Sheets and track daily outbound
 metrics.

________________________________________

Compensation & Benefits



• Base Salary: $5.00 – $8.00 / hour (Paid based on experience and onboarding speed).

• Guaranteed Pay Increases: Structured hourly rate bumps built into your contract upon passing your 90-day review and tracking with long-term performance milestones.

• Guaranteed Bonuses: Fixed cash performance bonuses awarded for successful technical milestones and active client account retention.

• Health Insurance Allowance: A guaranteed monthly health allowance is provided within your first 6 months of employment to cover your private HMO or PhilHealth costs.

• Paid Time Off (PTO): Full PTO benefits unlocked automatically after your first 6 months of employment.

________________________________________

Required Qualifications & Skills



• OnlineJobs.ph Verification: An ID Proof Score of 70 or higher is strongly preferred to ensure an established, verified account history.

• Advanced GoHighLevel (GHL) Experience: Deep, hands-on knowledge of GHL sub-accounts, workflows, custom values, calendars, and phone settings is mandatory.

• A2P 10DLC Compliance: Strong familiarity with setting up and troubleshooting A2P registration inside GHL is a BIG PLUS. You should know how to get brand and campaign registrations approved quickly to avoid SMS filtering.

• Process-Oriented Thinking: Proven ability to explain complex technical setups clearly through written guides or recorded video walkthroughs (Loom).

• Exceptional English (Spoken & Written): You will talk directly to US-based contractors over the phone and
, as well as test voice AI systems. Flawless communication is required.

• Telephony & API Logic: Strong understanding of webhooks, JSON data mapping, and phone routing (Twilio, call forwarding, bridging). Experience with Voice AI automation inside GHL is a massive plus.

• High Attention to Detail: Zero tolerance for typos, broken automation paths, or messy databases.

________________________________________

How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)



We receive a massive amount of automated applications. To prove you actually read this and possess the attention to detail required for an Operations Manager role, you must follow these steps:



1. Change the subject line of your application message to exactly: "GHL Specialist for Hire" (Any application without this exact subject line will be deleted instantly).



2. Include a screenshot of your internet speed from Speedtest.net.



3. Provide a brief summary answering these three things:

- A specific GoHighLevel setup or 
 workflow you built that you are proud of (bonus points if you have built a Missed-Call Text-Back or Google Review workflow before).

- Your experience handling client support via phone and
.

- Your experience (if any) creating technical SOPs or training guides for software.

title: Shopify Product Lister Specialist
description:
📋SUMMARY



We need a Shopify product lister for Q4 — and beyond.



Products arrive already researched and sourced. You turn each one into a finished product page: import it, clean the imported mess, price it from our cost figure, build the specs, set the variants, assign our page template, configure the backend, set up reviews, and QA it on your phone before it goes live. Then you log it in our Google Sheet so the next person can pick it up.



You don't write copy and you don't make images — we have people for both.



🎄 Why This Q4 Matters



We donate a percentage of this season's profit to a charity that gets Christmas gifts to kids whose parents can't afford them. More products live and converting means more gifts. You won't feel that in every spreadsheet row, but it's why we care that the work is done properly instead of fast and sloppy.



🧠 What We're Looking For



✦ You have built real Shopify product pages before — send links to pages you built (proof of work)

✦ You know your way around the Shopify theme editor: duplicating templates, assigning them, placing sections

✦ You have imported products with an importer app and cleaned up the mess it leaves behind

✦ You have handled product reviews before — bulk import, not one at a time

✦ You know landed cost, markup and margin. You never price a product without knowing what it costs us

✦ Strong written US English — you're not writing copy, you're fixing broken imported text and formatting it

✦ Mobile first. 99% of our visitors arrive from Instagram and
 ads on a phone

✦ You work fast without getting sloppy. Q4 is a volume season, and a rushed page costs us more than a slow one

✦ Reliable and organized — we should not have to double-check your work

✦ You follow a written SOP exactly, and you tell us when a step in it is wrong so we can fix it



🧰 Tools You'll Work In Daily



✦ Shopify admin + theme editor

✦ A product import app

✦ A review import app

✦ Google Sheets (our product tracker) and Google Drive

✦ AI assistant for conversions and formatting

✦ Group chat for daily communication



🛠 Your Main Tasks



✦ Import the product and strip everything unusable — leftover branding, broken characters, non-English text, claims we can't back

✦ Price it from our cost figure using our markup and discount rules, then get the price approved

✦ Build the page to the SOP: specs, "what's in the box", US units (inches / oz / lbs)

✦ Set up variants — right image per variant, no duplicates, short list

✦ Duplicate and assign our page template, then log the link

✦ Configure the backend: inventory, tax, sales channels, handle, SEO, product status

✦ Set up the product reviews and place the review widget

✦ QA the live page on your own phone — variants, buttons, cart, upsells, checkout

✦ Log every product in our sheet and move it to the next status so the rest of the team knows it's their turn



📚 What You Get From Us



A written step-by-step SOP with screenshots for every phase of this job, including our pricing rules, our backend settings and our review process. You are not guessing what "done" means — it is written down. The first products are done together with us so you get our standards in your hands, then you run on your own.



💰 Pay



Hourly. We don't post a fixed rate because it depends on your experience and speed — tell us your hourly rate in your proposal and we'll discuss it on the interview call. Quote what you actually want to work for; we'd rather agree on a fair number once than renegotiate in November.



No maximum hours. Our researcher is sourcing products constantly, so the list refills faster than it empties. The limit is how many products you can finish properly per day, not how much work exists.



⏱ Timeline



Starting this week. Q4 is the whole point — we can't start this in November.



🚀 What's Next



Short-term for Q4 to start, with a real chance of ongoing work into 2027 if the work is strong. The people who do this well become the people we build the next season around.



📋 How to Apply



1. Start your proposal with the word LISTED so we know you read this.



2. Send links to 2 live Shopify product pages you built yourself, and tell us in one line what you were responsible for on each.



3. Record a 60–90 second Loom: who you are, and walk us through one product page you built — including what you would fix on it today. No script, phone audio is fine.



4. Answer these three questions in your proposal. Short answers, no essays:



   A) A product imports with 14 variants. Half have no image and the names look like "Red-L-2pcs-CN". What do you do before this page goes live, and what do you delete entirely?



   B) Say a product costs $8.50 landed. What do you sell it for, what compare-at price do you put next to it, and why that compare-at and not a higher one?



   C) The page looks perfect on desktop. Name the first three things you check on your phone — and one thing you have personally seen break on mobile that looked fine on desktop.



5. Which import app and which review app have you worked with before?



6. Your hourly rate and how many hours per week you can commit.



Shortlisted applicants get one paid test product — build it end to end, paid, and it d
 the hire.



⚠️ Only apply if you can show real proof of work on Shopify product pages. We're not training from zero on Shopify. Applications without the Loom and without the questions answered are not reviewed.

title: YouTube Upload VA — Must Have Anti-Detect Browser + Proxy Experience

title: Senior Email Automation & Deliverability Expert Needed — High-Volume Operation
description:
We’re looking for an exceptional
 automation and deliverability expert to help us build and manage a reliable, scalable
 infrastructure.



This is not a basic newsletter or Klaviyo position.



We operate in the performance marketing and traffic industry. We already have the demand and capacity to sell up to 20,000 clicks per day. Our current bottleneck is consistently generating and delivering that volume while maintaining strong inbox placement, engagement, domain reputation and IP health.



What We Need



We need someone who can audit our current operation, identify exactly what is limiting our deliverability, and build a system capable of scaling responsibly.



You should be able to help with:



Complete deliverability and infrastructure audit

 automation architecture

ESP and SMTP selection

Sending-domain and subdomain configuration

SPF, DKIM, DMARC, rDNS and custom tracking-domain setup

Dedicated IP management and warming

Gmail, Microsoft and Yahoo reputation management

Google Postmaster Tools and Microsoft SNDS monitoring

Automated domain, IP and campaign-health monitoring

Bounce, complaint and suppression management

List validation, hygiene and engagement segmentation

Inbox-placement and seed-list testing

Campaign scheduling and volume allocation

Automated workflows based on subscriber engagement

Tracking and reporting dashboards

Troubleshooting sudden inboxing or reputation problems

Creating documented SOPs our team can follow



Experience with tools such as MailWizz, Mautic, PowerMTA, Postal, Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, GlockApps, Everest, Inbox Monster, Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, MillionVerifier or comparable systems is valuable.



We are open to your recommended technology stack. We care more about proven results than attachment to any particular platform.



The Goal



We want to develop a stable, compliant system that can generate and fulfil a substantial daily volume of genuine clicks without constantly damaging domains or IPs.



We understand that no legitimate expert can guarantee a specific inbox rate or immediately produce 20,000 daily clicks. We want someone who can:



Establish our current baseline.

Diagnose the real bottlenecks.

Create a realistic scaling plan.

Implement the infrastructure and automation.

Measure performance by mailbox provider.

Improve results without relying on deceptive practices or temporary tricks.

Who We’re Looking For



You must have genuine, hands-on experience managing high-volume
 infrastructure.



We are not looking for:



General
 copywriters

Basic automation builders

People whose only experience is sending small newsletters

Someone who simply recommends buying more domains

Anyone using spam-filter evasion, fake engagement or other short-term tactics



The right person understands that deliverability is affected by acquisition source, consent, engagement, complaints, list quality, authentication, infrastructure and sending behaviour—not just
 copy.



To Apply



Please answer every question below:



What is the highest legitimate daily
 volume you have personally managed?

Which ESPs, SMTP platforms and mailing systems have you worked with?

Describe one deliverability problem you diagnosed and solved. Include the starting position, what you changed and the measurable result.

How do you monitor Gmail, Microsoft and Yahoo separately?

What information would you need before recommending an infrastructure?

How do you determine whether the problem is the list, content, domain, IP, tracking setup or sending pattern?

What would your first 14 days working with us look like?

Which deliverability practices will you refuse to use?

Can you provide verifiable case studies, screenshots or references?



Applications containing vague claims such as “I guarantee 100% inboxing” will be rejected.



Engagement Structure



We would prefer to begin with a paid technical audit and implementation plan.



If your diagnosis is strong and you can demonstrate the required experience, this can become a substantial implementation and ongoing management contract.



Please begin your application with the words “DELIVERABILITY AUDIT” so we know you have read the complete brief.

title: Creative Designer | Product Page Images & Static Ads
description:
📋SUMMARY



We need a creative designer for Q4 — and beyond.



We test a lot of products fast. Every product that comes to you is already researched, sourced and listed. Your job is to make it sell visually, and you deliver two things per product:



1. The product page image set — the product page gallery a visitor scrolls through.

2. A batch of static ads — 3 to 6 image ads, each with a different hook, built to stop a scroll in the
 and Instagram feed.



*Page images explain to someone already interested. 

*Ads have to earn the click from a stranger without clickbaiting.



This is a design role with a copywriting half. You get a market research document and approved page copy for every product, and you write the short copy that goes on the images yourself — the headline, the benefit line, the feature line. We're not asking you to write the product page. We are asking you to pull the right desire out of a research doc and say it in eight words on an image.



You don't edit video — we have someone for that.



🎄 Why This Q4 Matters



We donate a percentage of this store's profit to a charity that gets Christmas gifts to kids whose parents can't afford them. It's why we care that the work is done properly and fast.



🧠 What We're Looking For



✦ A lot of experience designing e-commerce product images and static ads — this is the core of the role.

✦ Strong Canva skills. You work inside an existing brand template without breaking it

✦ You can write the copy that goes on your designs — headlines, benefit lines, hooks, in the customer's words

✦ You can read a market research document and find the desire that actually makes someone buy

✦ You mastered AI generative tools

✦ Mobile first, and fast. 99% of our traffic is on a phone, and Q4 is a volume season



🧰 Tools You'll Work In Daily



✦ Canva (our brand templates live there)

✦ Higgsfield for AI tools

✦ Google Drive — research documents, source material and deliverables

✦ 
 — where we feedback each version

✦ Google Sheets — our product tracker

✦ 
 for daily communication



🛠 Your Main Tasks



✦ Read the research and the live product page, then d
 the angle

✦ Write the image copy: main benefit, supporting feature, a different hook per ad

✦ Build the product page image set in our Canva template

✦ Build the static ad batch

✦ Source and improve the visuals with AI, generating new product-in-use shots where nothing usable exists

✦ Deliver into our folders, process feedback into new versions, and log what you built



📚 What You Get From Us



A written step-by-step SOP with screenshots covering every phase of this role — the template structure, the copy hierarchy on each image, the naming conventions, the review process. You are not guessing what "done" means. A full market research document and approved page copy come with every product, so you always know who the buyer is and what they want before you write a word. The first product is done together with us.

✦ Hourly — rate discussed on application. No maximum hours: research runs constantly, so the list refills constantly. The limit is how much you can process accurately.

   A) The only usable photo of a product is a blurry screenshot from a competitor's video. Walk us through what you actually do to get a usable image out of it.

title: Procurement and Logistics Manager
description:
Procurement & Logistics Manager 



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly analytical, proactive, and hands-on Procurement & Logistics Manager with specialized experience in the Amazon ecosystem (FBA/FBM). In this role, you will oversee end-to-end supply chain operations, from global vendor sourcing and purchase order management to international freight forwarding, 3PL hub management, and inbound distribution into Amazon Fulfillment Centers.



Your primary focus will be maintaining optimal stock levels, protecting inventory health metrics (IPI score), optimizing total landed costs, and building resilient supplier partnerships to support scalable e-commerce growth.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Inventory & FBA Operations Management

Manage daily FBA inventory workflows within Amazon Seller Central (and/or Vendor Central), including shipping plan creation, box content information, pallet specifications, and tracking inbound shipments.

Continuously monitor and optimize Inventory Performance Index (IPI) scores, restock limits, capacity limits, and aged inventory metrics to minimize overage and storage fees while preventing stockouts.

Ensure 100% compliance with Amazon prep, labeling, packaging, and routing requirements to eliminate prep chargebacks, processing delays, or vendor chargebacks.

Coordinate stock transfers between 3PL warehouses and Amazon FCs based on regional velocity, seasonal spikes, and FC receiving lead times.

2. Sourcing, Procurement & Vendor Management

Lead end-to-end purchase order (PO) generation, issuing, and status tracking with overseas and domestic manufacturing partners.

Negotiate pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQs), payment terms, and production lead times with suppliers to optimize cash flow and gross margins.

Establish supplier KPI dashboards to evaluate factory performance regarding defect rates, on-time delivery rates, and order fulfillment accuracy.

Identify secondary sourcing options for critical high-velocity SKUs to mitigate single-supplier dependency risks.

3. Global Logistics & Freight Coordination

Oversee international freight forwarding operations (Ocean FCL/LCL, Air Freight, Express Parcel, and DDP/FOB shipments) from factory gates to domestic destinations.

Partner with customs brokers and freight partners to ensure accurate HTS code classification, duty/tariff compliance, and smooth customs clearance.

Calculate, audit, and optimize total landed costs (unit cost + freight + duties + 3PL + Amazon fulfillment fees) to drive bottom-line profitability.

4. Demand Planning & Inventory Forecasting

Build and maintain dynamic demand forecasting models using historical sales velocity, organic search rankings, marketing campaigns, and seasonal events (e.g., Prime Day, Q4 Holiday Season).

Establish target reorder points (ROP), safety stock levels, and replenishment schedules across all product lines.

Perform weekly/monthly inventory reconciliations across Seller Central, 3PL physical stock, and internal ERP/inventory systems.



Qualifications & Skill Requirements



Required Experience

3–5+ years of direct experience in procurement, supply chain, or logistics for an e-commerce brand.

Must have hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central (Inbound Shipping Plans, FBA Inventory Dashboard, Inventory Performance Index, Restock Limits).

Proven track record managing international freight logistics (specifically Asia-to-US/EU shipping lanes, customs, and ocean/air freight).

Strong command of Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions: VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, forecasting models).

Experience working with third-party logistics (3PL) providers and prep centers.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience using supply chain software or ERP tools (e.g., NetSuite, Katana, InventoryLab, RestockPro, or similar).

Knowledge of multi-channel fulfillment models (Walmart Marketplace, Shopify Direct-to-Consumer, TikTok Shop).



How to Apply

Interested candidates should send a message with the subject: “Overqualified for coffee runs, perfect for Procurement and Logistics.” The cover letter should consist of your years of experience related to the job post. Send it together with your resume link.

title: Video Editor for Meta Ads
description:
Job description



We're a UK-based e-commerce business running a high volume of Meta ads 
 and Instagram). Creative is the biggest driver of our results, and we test a lot of it. We're looking for a fast, creative video editor who can come up with scroll-stopping hooks, use AI tools to work at speed, and produce a steady volume of ad variations every week.



This is not a "polish one video a week" role. We need someone who loves direct-response ads, thinks in hooks and angles, and can turn one piece of footage into many ads.



What you'll be doing



Editing short-form video ads (mostly 15–60 seconds) from raw footage, UGC-style clips, product shots and presenter videos

Writing and testing multiple hooks for each ad (the first 3 seconds), not just editing the ones we give you

Producing a high volume of variations every week: different hooks, angles, captions, lengths and calls to action

Using AI tools to speed up editing, generate voiceovers, create B-roll and visuals, and produce new angles from existing footage

Formatting for all placements: 9:16 (Reels/Stories), 4:5 and 1:1 (Feed)

Adding captions, text overlays, simple motion graphics, music and sound effects

Refreshing and remixing past winning ads based on performance feedback

Keeping files organised and named consistently so we can track what's being tested



What we're looking for



Proven experience editing ads for
, Instagram or TikTok (please include examples)

A strong understanding of direct-response advertising and what makes people stop scrolling

Able to come up with your own hook ideas and angles, not just follow a brief

Hands-on experience with AI tools for video and ad production, such as CapCut AI features, Runway, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Midjourney, Opus Clip or similar

Confident with Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects

Comfortable working at pace, turning one piece of footage into 5–10+ variations

Takes feedback well and iterates quickly

Good written English and clear communication

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle HD/4K footage



Nice to have



Experience with UK or US audiences

Motion graphics or animation skills

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or creative testing

Experience with e-commerce or product-based brands





How to apply

Please send:



Links to 3–5 ad videos you've edited (Google Drive, YouTube or portfolio)

title: Finance & Payment Operations Specialist
description:
This is a finance operations role, not a bookkeeping role.



We are a US direct-to-consumer telehealth company. We sell a subscription product, we spend on paid ads every day, and we run payments through more than one merchant account. Most of the numbers currently live in the founder's head and in a dozen separate dashboards. Your job is to get them into one weekly report that leadership can trust, and to see payment and cash risk coming before it becomes a problem.



You will sit between finance, subscription payments, paid acquisition, customer operations, and vendors. The work directly shapes how much the company spends on ads and how fast it grows.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Weekly reporting and reconciliation



Build and maintain the weekly executive KPI pack

Reconcile orders, rebill revenue, refunds, chargebacks, processor settlements, ad spend, and cash movement across source systems

Report revenue, contribution margin, CAC, approval rates, retention, and cash conversion in one place instead of five

Find discrepancies between systems and chase them down before the numbers go to leadership

Payment and merchant account operations



Maintain a weekly capacity map across processors: volume caps, reserves, approval rates, decline rates, chargeback thresholds, and routing rules

Monitor processor balances, settlements, rolling reserves, pending payouts, and any unusual change in payment performance

Support routing decisions and raise the flag early when an account approaches a cap or a risk threshold

Keep accurate records of processor fees, limits, reserves, and renewal dates

Cash forecasting and unit economics



Maintain a short-term cash and reserve forecast covering ad spend, settlement timing, reserves, fulfillment and clinical costs, refunds, and payroll

Track cohort economics and all-in profitability per customer, including CAC, fulfillment, clinician cost, processing, refunds, chargebacks, and commissions

Flag clearly when performance falls outside the agreed scaling limits

Help leadership tell the difference between revenue growth and profitable, cash-safe growth

Vendor and contract records



Maintain the contract register for material vendors: owner, status, commercial terms, renewal and termination dates

Collect and organize supporting documents for processors, pharmacies, clinician networks, and checkout platforms

Keep financial, payment, and contract materials current and easy to verify

Handle sensitive financial and vendor information with complete discretion



YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS



Get read-only access to the ad platforms, the checkout and subscription platform, the payment processors, and settlement reporting

Deliver the first repeatable weekly KPI pack, with sources and reconciliation notes written down

Deliver the first processor capacity map and reserve forecast

Document the payment routing and escalation procedure

Build the contract register for payment, clinical, pharmacy, and checkout vendors

If those five things exist and are reliable at day 30, this role is working.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Strong Excel or Google Sheets: complex formulas, pivots, data cleanup, and clean reporting. This is the core skill and we will test it

Real experience in finance ops, revenue ops, payment ops, or e-commerce operations

Experience reconciling data across multiple systems and finding the cause of a discrepancy, not just the size of it

Comfort with subscriptions and rebills, refunds, chargebacks, and settlement timing

The judgment to turn messy data into a short report with clear conclusions and honest open questions

Ability to work independently and remotely, and to be trusted with confidential financial information

Clear written English



HELPFUL TO HAVE



Multi-processor or high-risk payment environments, merchant accounts, rolling reserves, routing

DTC subscription, telehealth, pharmacy, or other compliance-sensitive operations

Stripe, CheckoutChamp, GoHighLevel, PostHog, Meta Ads, Google Ads or similar

Cash forecasts, cohort models, contribution margin reporting

Bookkeeping or accounting background, CPA studies, or controller support experience



WHAT WE PAY



Starts at $2,000 per month 



THE SETUP



Full-time and remote. Most of the work is on your own schedule, with at least four hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours so you can raise payment issues while someone is awake.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your message with the word RECONCILE

2. Record a 3-5 minute loom video where you introduce yourself, walk us through your experience. Also, describe one time you found a discrepancy between two systems. What the two systems were, how you found it, and what was actually causing it.

3. Tell us about one spreadsheet or report you built that other people still use, and what it replaced

4. Shortlisted candidates get a short data exercise: a small anonymized set of orders, refunds, settlements, and ad spend, with a rolling reserve. We will ask you to produce a reconciled weekly summary, three things you would investigate, and one cash observation.



Please answer in your own words. Applications that skip the instructions above will not be read.

This is a warm, people-first role clients reaching out are frequently anxious or overwhelmed, and how you handle that first call matters as much as the paperwork.

Client communication



Answer inbound calls, voi
s,

title: Digital Operations Assistant
description:
Location: Fully Remote

Position: Full-time, freelance

Working hours: 8 hours per day, 5–6 days per week



We’re looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Digital Operations Assistant to support our team with a variety of online and administrative activities.



The position involves working with digital information, online resources, internal systems, and recurring workflows. You’ll be given established procedures and clear priorities, while also being expected to manage your assigned work independently and communicate when something requires attention.



This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys structured computer-based work, pays close attention to details, and is comfortable learning new tools and processes.



What You'll Do



Your responsibilities may include:



Digital & Administrative Tasks



Working with spreadsheets, online platforms, internal tools, and shared resources

Organizing information and maintaining internal records when required

Preparing simple reports, lists, or summaries

Updating operational documentation when procedures change

Performing basic research to support specific assignments

Preparing or organizing digital materials when needed

Assisting team members with ad hoc administrative and online tasks



Operational Support



Carrying out recurring operational workflows based on established procedures

Managing assigned tasks from initial instruction through completion

Keeping track of outstanding work and ensuring deadlines are met

Reviewing task requirements before beginning an assignment

Following up on incomplete or unclear items when necessary

Maintaining internal operational resources and documentation

Supporting the implementation of updated procedures and workflows

Assisting with new projects and other operational priorities as they arise



Quality & Process Checks



Reviewing completed work to ensure it meets established requirements

Identifying errors, inconsistencies, or unusual cases

Making straightforward corrections when appropriate

Escalating issues that require additional information or a management decision

Performing recurring checks on assigned processes and resources

Helping identify recurring problems or areas where a workflow could be improved

Recording relevant issues and observations for supervisors



Project & Team Support



Taking responsibility for individual assignments or small projects

Providing progress updates on ongoing work

Communicating delays, questions, or potential problems in a timely manner

Helping test new workflows or tools before they are introduced more broadly

Supporting supervisors with additional tasks as business priorities develop

The exact combination of responsibilities will vary depending on current projects and operational needs.



What Makes You a Good Fit:



English language proficiency (both verbal and written) 

Working knowledge of Google Workspace apps (Docs, Sheets, Drive, etc.)

Strong research skills

Diligent and dedicated work ethic

Ability to complete tasks efficiently and accurately while adhering to time constraints

Comfortable spending most of your workday working at a computer (8 hours or more if needed)

Ability to manage deadlines effectively and comfortable using productivity-tracking tools 



Essential Setup



Reliable computer or laptop

Stable internet connection

Ability to work comfortably with multiple online platforms and browser-based tools



What You Can Expect:



Working schedule: This is a completely remote, full-time position requiring 8 working hours per day. We are ideally looking for someone available to work 6 days per week (Monday–Saturday), though a 5-day workweek (Monday–Friday) can also be accommodated.



Our team primarily operates in the CET time zone. However, we offer flexibility regarding your working hours, which can be agreed upon with management based on your availability and the team's needs.



Please note that the 8-hour workday should be completed in one continuous working period, with regular breaks as needed. Working hours can’t be split into separate periods throughout the day.



Contract: As this is a freelance position, you’ll work under a freelance contract. Please note that, unlike a standard employment contract, this arrangement doesn’t include employee benefits or employer-provided contributions such as taxes, social security, or insurance.



Time Off: Time away from work can be arranged in advance with management, subject to the team's workload and operational requirements. Approved time off is unpaid.



Compensation: The starting hourly rate is $3, with estimated monthly earnings of $520–$620, depending on the agreed-upon work schedule.



Please note that, as this is a freelance position, compensation is calculated and paid on an hourly basis rather than as a fixed monthly salary. Payments are monthly.



We also regularly review our team members’ rates based on their performance, reliability, and overall contribution to the team, with opportunities for rate increases and growth over time.



What’s Next?



Selected candidates will begin with a one-month trial period.



During this period, you will receive detailed guidance on our systems, procedures, and expectations. As you become familiar with the work, you will gradually take greater responsibility for your assigned tasks.



Recruitment Process



The selection process includes:



A short initial questionnaire

Two short practical assessments

Interview



The assessments are designed to evaluate skills relevant to the position and are used solely for recruitment purposes. They aren’t part of our regular business operations and are therefore unpaid. Successful candidates will be invited for an interview.



Only candidates who meet the initial requirements will be contacted regarding the first recruitment stage.



Interested?



If you are organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently with digital information, we'd be happy to hear from you.

Position Summary



The HR Operations & Compliance Coordinator is a key member of the Human Resources team responsible for supporting a broad range of HR functions across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, benefits administration, policy administration, compliance, and day-to-day HR operations. This is a true HR generalist role suited for a dynamic professional who can balance operational execution with thoughtful employee support.

The Company’s HR function operates within its broader Legal and Compliance structure under the oversight of the General Counsel. In this role, the Coordinator will work closely with the HR Manager, General Counsel, legal team, and other internal stakeholders to help ensure HR processes are efficient, consistent, and compliant.



Although broad in scope, this role places particular emphasis on employee relations, leave management, and compliance. The ideal candidate will be skilled at navigating sensitive workplace matters, supporting investigations and conflict resolution, managing leave and accommodation processes, and exercising sound judgment when handling confidential and complex employee issues.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities



Employee Relations Support

> Assist with employee relations investigations and fact-finding conversations under the direction of the HR Manager.

> Take detailed and objective notes during employee meetings and investigations.

> Prepare written summaries and employee statements in a neutral and factual manner.

> Conduct timely follow-up with employees, managers, and other stakeholders as directed.

> Organize and maintain investigation files and legal documentation.

> Track employee relations matters and maintain case management records.



Leave of Absence Administration

> Assist with administration of leave requests, including medical leave, maternity leave, and other protected leaves.

> Respond to leave-related inquiries and provide appropriate notices and paperwork based on the employee's situation.

> Track completion and return of required documentation.

> Maintain accurate leave records and monitor deadlines.

> Coordinate with onshore and offshore support teams to ensure timely processing.



ADA Accommodation Process

> Support the interactive accommodation process under the supervision of the HR Manager.

> Review accommodation requests and supporting medical documentation.

> Validate receipt and completeness of physician certifications and related documentation.

> Track accommodation requests and maintain required records.

> Coordinate communications with employees, managers, and third-party providers as needed.



Compliance & Training Administration

> Maintain compliance training records and generate weekly training reports.

> Verify employee compensation for required training has been processed appropriately.

> Follow up with managers regarding overdue training requirements.

> Coordinate annual labor law poster compliance and distribution.

> Assist with implementation and tracking of compliance initiatives.



HR Operations & Administration

> Issue company communications related to payroll schedules, holidays, office closures, and other operational updates.

> Assist with onboarding and administration of independent contractors and 1099 engagements.

> Coordinate ad hoc background screening requests for healthcare professionals and other specialized positions.

> Assist with annual performance review administration and tracking.

Employment Eligibility & Compliance

> Maintain working knowledge of Form I-9 requirements and employment eligibility verification procedures.

> Provide guidance and training support to offshore team members regarding I-9 processing.

> Assist with E-Verify administration and maintenance.

> Support audits and compliance reviews related to employment eligibility documentation.

Benefits Administration

> Assist with benefits administration activities, including government contract-related benefit requirements.

> Support annual Open Enrollment activities.

> Assist with 401(k) enrollment and administrative processes.

> Maintain PTO administration systems and employee records.



Policy & Process Support

> Under the guidance of the HR Manager, assist with interpreting company policies and applicable employment laws.

> Provide administrative support for policy implementation and compliance initiatives.

> Identify opportunities for process improvements and recommend efficiencies to enhance HR operations.

Qualifications

> 3+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Leave Administration, Benefits, Compliance, or HR Operations.

> Strong working knowledge of leave administration, ADA accommodations, employee relations practices, I-9 compliance, and general employment law; experience supporting multi-state employers is preferred.

> Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive, complex, and highly confidential matters with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment.

> Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess facts, identify risks, and escalate issues appropriately.

> Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.

> Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

> Experience working with HRIS platforms, case management systems, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace applications, including strong Excel and documentation skills.

> Ability to work independently, exercise good judgment, and collaborate effectively with HR, management, and legal stakeholders.



Reporting Relationship

This position reports directly to the Benefits & Business Operation Manager and works closely with the Human Resources leadership team and the Company’s General Counsel on employee relations, compliance, and other sensitive HR matters.

title: Job description - Product lister
description:
Job description - Product lister



Our e-commerce company is hiring! We are looking for a full-time E-Commerce Lister to join our team, someone with a thorough understanding of Shopify and paid advertising. You will make sure that our product listings are optimized for conversions and the descriptions are appealing to website visitors.



What does a Product lister do?

A Product lister is mainly responsible for listing new products on the Shopify store. This may involve writing content to describe listings, product photography, measuring weights and dimensions, and SEO. This may also involve helping to improve older listings to maximize sales. Marketing skills are required!



Responsibilities and Duties

• Creating new product listings on our Shopify store.

• Writing content to describe products, adding and editing images, GIFs, re-direct links,

• Accurately compare the products with the ones from our supplier.

• Improving old product listings with updated descriptions and images.

• Reviewing marketing materials, websites and presentations to ensure compliance with the regulations of the advertising platforms

Qualifications and Skills

• Marketing oriented. Marketing is your genuine interest and you love shopping online.

• Technically savvy. You love all things related to technical details. You are quick to learn and are known for your technical capabilities.

• Have a high attention to detail. When it comes to details, nothing gets past you.. and we mean nothing! So much so that we want you to include "the devil is in the details" as the answer to the first question when you submit your application. Seriously.

• Passion for process and systems. You love structure, order, and workflows. You naturally build out process flows in everything you do.

• Thrives in a fast paced environment. You get excited working at a fast pace and have a proven track record of flawless execution. You have a strong ability to multi-task and stay organized.

• You do what you say. You are passionate about delivering results and you always finish what you start. You take pride in being able to keep your word.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills



Product lister experience requirements

Preferably you have a couple of years experience in this field, and have worked for other drop shipping companies that ship products from Asia to Europe. You must understand how paid advertising works, in the sense that you know how sending traffic to an online store should lead to conversions.



Salary Expectations

You will start as Trainee Product lister, where you will be working on the side of the company owner, 3-6 hrs per day with compensation of $5/hr.



We always start with a one-month trial with a contract via UpWork, to ensure safety for both parties. After that, we'll have an evaluation to see if both parties would like to proceed to work together. If yes, you will be promoted to Product lister with an increased compensation to $6/hr.



Benefits

• Get to work in a young company with lots of ambitions

• Work fully remote

• Get paid every two weeks, instead of once per month (13 times per year)

• Upgrade your knowledge and skills in the fastest growing industry: digital marketing



If you can commit to and live with the following principles, then you are the type of person who will be successful and help our company thrive. If you feel this level of engagement is not right for you or that you're not willing or able to participate with us at this level, we are not a good fit for you.



Our expectation is that you will take the steps necessary to do what you say you are going to do and be accountable for your actions. In other words, live 'Above the line'.



Are you looking for a new adventure? Make sure you apply today!



Kind regards,

Jorge Quiroga Cabezas

title: Accounts & Finance Specialist - Own the Entire Finance Function of an Australian Business
description:
Own the entire finance function of an established, profitable Australian consumer products business. All of it - payments, payroll, cashflow, receivables, supplier reconciliation, leave and compliance - plus the analysis on top: forecasting, margin work, supplier negotiation modelling, and the numbers the directors use to make decisions.



You are not on your own. An outsourced partner handles the bookkeeping and provides a financial controller. But you are the finance function inside the business, and you report straight to a director.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗷𝗼𝗯 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲



About 60% is the rhythm that keeps the business running. Payments most mornings, cashflow updated, payroll every fortnight, reconciliation weekly, month-end monthly. Get it right, get it out on time - a lot of people downstream are waiting on you.



About 30% is working things out. Why is our shipping costing more than we charge for it? What is that supplier rebate really worth before we agree to it? How has this cost been sitting in the wrong account for a year? Which week are we going to be tight, and how early can we see it coming?



The last 10% is making the first 60% smaller and better. Cutting steps out of a process, automating what a machine should be doing, and spending the time you win back on quality.



We have a technical contractor who will build whatever you specify. You will not automate all of it and we are not expecting that - but if you make a daily task disappear, that is a win, and we will not quietly fill the time with something else.



Each part feeds the others - you spot the odd number because you did the reconciliation yourself. The people who do well here want all three: clean books, numbers they actually understand, and something in the business working better because of what they found and then did about it.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲



We are a team of 18 across Australia and the Philippines. Our Philippine team has been the operational backbone of this business for years - not a support function, the people who run it day to day.



We hold a high standard on the work rather than on hours at a desk, and we back your decisions.



The flip side is that we are direct. You will get clear feedback, and we expect the same back. You can raise a mistake, say you are not sure, or tell a director they are wrong, and none of those cost you anything here. What does not work is quietly letting something slide.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗼𝘄𝗻



• The daily payment cycle, supplier coordination, receivables and refunds



• Fortnightly payroll submission, with our outsourced bookkeeping team processing the run



• Cashflow forecasting - maintaining it, improving it, and flagging problems before they arrive



• Warranty claim finance with our main supplier, including reconciliation and claim modelling



• Month-end close, the monthly finance report, and the metrics on it



• Leave records, compliance renewals, and software subscription costs



• The relationship with our outsourced finance partner - you run it, not us



• Whatever analysis a director needs, and the analysis nobody asked for but should have



𝗥𝗼𝗼𝗺 𝘁𝗼 𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗲𝗮𝘁: some of the financial controller work currently sits with our external partner. If you have the capability, there is scope to bring more of that in-house over time.



𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗱𝗼 𝘄𝗲𝗹𝗹 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝗳



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗴𝗲𝘁 𝘂𝗽 𝘁𝗼 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝘁. You are stepping into an established function rather than building one from scratch. We are looking for someone who can be genuinely self-sufficient within a few weeks, not a few months.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗱𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀. Given a call that sits inside your remit, you make it and tell us what you did - rather than writing up the options and waiting.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲. When someone owes you something and the date passes, you follow up the next day, without agonising about whether they will find it annoying. This matters more in this role than almost anything else.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗴𝗼 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴. The best work in this seat comes from noticing something odd in the numbers and following it before anyone asks you to.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀. Including the documentation, which is the part everyone skips.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗳𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻 𝗲𝘅𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗶𝗿 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗱 𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗴, and explaining why.



• 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗰𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆. Most of how we work is written, and clarity beats volume.



𝗢𝗻𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗯𝗲 𝗰𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿 𝗼𝗻. There is no finance team - you will have colleagues across the business, but you are the only person in this seat.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱



• 3+ years owning a finance or accounts function in a real operating business - not a bookkeeping seat inside a larger finance team, and not high-volume BPO processing



• Comfortable across a P&L, a balance sheet and a cashflow forecast - not just producing them, but reading them and knowing what a movement actually means



• Genuinely strong with spreadsheets - you build models, not just maintain them. Multi-scenario cashflow, sensitivity, reconciliation across systems.



• Payroll experience, and enough confidence to audit historical payroll records and find errors in them



• Experience working with an external bookkeeper or accountant, and holding them to dates



• Xero or equivalent; Notion or equivalent at builder level; a workflow automation tool (Zapier, Make, n8n) as a genuine user



• 𝗔𝗜 𝗶𝘀 𝗮𝗹𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸. You use it to move faster on analysis, process design and writing, and you edit and pressure-test what comes back. We want people who use AI to raise their output, not to paper over gaps in it.



• Written English at business-professional standard



• Standard hours 9am-6pm AEST/AEDT

title: Product research & sheet logging Specialist
description:
📋 SUMMARY

We run a Q4 e-commerce operation selling Christmas gift products for kids. Our product researcher finds potential winning products every day and drops the competitor profiles in our group chat. We need someone to turn that stream into clean, complete, decision-ready rows in a Google Sheet, so the owner can review the data and pick what we test.



*You are NOT finding products and you are NOT d
 what we sell. The owner does both. You own everything in between: the competitor research, the data, and the quality of the sheet.



🎄 Why This Q4 Matters

We donate a percentage of our Q4 profit to a charity that buys Christmas gifts for kids whose parents cannot afford them. The more products we test successfully, the more gifts that becomes. Nothing gets tested unless the research behind it is solid — that is your part.



🧠 What We're Looking For



✦ Proven data entry or research VA experience in Google Sheets (send proof of work — a sheet you built or maintained)

✦ Real online research skill — you can find a brand's product page, their best-performing content and its exact view count, and a rough supplier cost on Alibaba/AliExpress without hand-holding

✦ Obsessive attention to detail — our score formula reads cells literally, so "maybe" instead of "no", or 1.7M instead of
, breaks the row

✦ Commercial judgement — you can answer "would a grandparent buy this for a kid at Christmas?" without a rulebook for every case

✦ Consistency over speed — you notice when a row contradicts the 40 rows above it

✦ Reliable and organized — we shouldn't have to double-check your work

✦ Bonus: e-com/dropshipping VA background, Alibaba price-checking, using AI (ChatGPT/Claude) to check category consistency and catch near-duplicates



🛠 Your Main Tasks



✦ Research each shared competitor profile and log it as one complete row

✦ Spot duplicates before they enter the sheet

✦ Keep category naming identical across the whole sheet

✦ Verify the product is real, not a fake or AI-generated listing

✦ Flag each batch as ready for the owner's review

✦ Move approved rows to our second tab and build each product's Google Drive folder structure to our naming convention

✦ Communicate daily through 



💻 Tools

✦ Google Sheets

✦ Google Drive

✦ WhatsApp

✦ 

✦ Instagram

✦ TikTok

✦ Alibaba/AliExpress

✦ AI assistant of your choice.



📚 What You Get From Us

✦ A full written SOP with screenshots, a column-by-column guide, examples of right and wrong entries, and a pre-handover checklist. Explicit expectations from day one, not vague feedback in month two. 

✦ Direct feedback — if a batch has errors we point at the exact cells, and we expect the same directness back.



*We want a builder, not a filler. A filler does the rows and stops. A builder spots a gap in our SOP, tells us, and the next version is better because of them. That person gets kept.



💰 Pay

✦ Hourly — rate discussed on application. No maximum hours: research runs constantly, so the list refills constantly. The limit is how much you can process accurately.



⏱ Timeline

✦ Needed ASAP, starting this week. 

✦ Q4 project, roughly 2–3 months, winding down mid-December.



🚀 What's Next?

✦ We run this same Q4 operation next year starting in Q1 throughout 2027 for general products.

✦ We'd far rather keep someone who already knows the process than retrain a stranger.



📋 How to Apply



1. Start with the word "GIFT" so we know you read this.

2. Send a 60–90 second Loom: who you are, and one example of detail-heavy research or data work you've done. No script needed. Just being yourself is more than enough.

3. Answer these questions: 

✦ "Tell me about a time your data was wrong and someone caught it. What happened?"

✦ "A cell needs yes or no, and you genuinely can't d
. What do you do?"

✦ "What was the most tedious part of your last data job?"





Shortlisted applicants get a paid test task of 3–5 products. Under an hour, paid, and it d
 the hire.



⚠️ Only apply if you can show real proof of work in spreadsheet data entry or online research. Applications without the Loom and without an answers to the 3 questions are not reviewed.
