Video Editor for YouTube Commentary Channel



I’m looking for a skilled video editor to help edit content for The Uzo Show, a growing YouTube commentary channel focused on politics, culture, relationships, current events, and viral topics.



The editing style should feel similar to channels like MTR, Anton Daniels, Oshay Duke Jackson, and Brandon Lehman — clean, engaging, professional, and fast-paced without unnecessary animations every few seconds.



What You’ll Be Editing



Most videos will consist of:



Me reacting to or commenting on another video

Talking-head commentary

Split-screen reactions

News clips, TikToks, interviews, or viral videos

Occasional monologues

Your Responsibilities



You should be able to:



Remove mistakes, repeated sentences, awkward pauses, filler words, and dead space

Clean up awkward reactions or facial expressions when possible

Make my commentary flow naturally even if the raw recording is imperfect

Tighten pacing and remove anything that makes the video feel slow

Add strategic zoom-ins, punch-ins, and camera changes

Insert supporting screenshots, headlines, images, clips, or B-roll when appropriate

Add captions/text when it improves the video

Balance and improve audio

Understand comedic timing and commentary pacing

Turn raw footage into a polished video without needing constant instructions



I do not want excessive animations, sound effects, memes, or distracting edits. The personality and commentary should remain the focus.



Workload



Initially: 5–10 videos per week



Eventually: 10–15+ videos per week



Most videos will be approximately 10–30 minutes finished length.



This can grow into a consistent long-term position for the right editor.



Schedule



Approximately 25–30 hours per week to start.



Pay



Starting at approximately $700/month, depending on skill, speed, availability, and experience.



There will be opportunities for increased pay as the channel and workload grow.



Requirements

Strong English comprehension

Experience editing YouTube commentary, podcasts, reactions, or talking-head content

Fast turnaround

Reliable communication

Good judgment — you should know what to cut without destroying the speaker’s point

Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or similar professional editing software

Must be comfortable receiving large raw video files

TO APPLY



Send me:



2–3 examples of your best talking-head, commentary, reaction, or podcast edits

What editing software you use

Your typical turnaround time for a 15–20 minute finished video

Your internet speed

Your current availability

Start your application with the words “UZO SHOW” so I know you read the entire post.

Technical

What We Offer

* Work with a sharp, global creative and operations team.

If you want a role where you’re judged by output and growth, not meetings and politics, this is it.

This is not a narrowly defined administrative position. We want someone who can begin with an unclear objective, determine what needs to happen, and turn it into an organized, repeatable process.



For the right person, this position could grow into an Operations Manager or another leadership role.



What You May Work On



- Learn and manage portions of our client licensing process

- Research unfamiliar requirements and recommend practical solutions

- Document workflows and turn recurring work into standard operating procedures

- Build project trackers, quality-control systems, and internal dashboards

- Identify bottlenecks and improve inefficient processes

- Research new markets, services, and growth opportunities

- Test and improve AI-assisted workflows and business automations

- Evaluate and implement software tools

- Assist with website, SEO, content, or analytics projects

- Draft professional
s, client communications, and internal documentation

- Take ownership of important special projects from idea through completion

- Step into changing responsibilities as the company’s needs evolve



You will not be expected to know how to do everything immediately. You will be expected to learn quickly, ask intelligent questions, research independently, and take responsibility for producing a useful result.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:



- Have experience working in a startup, small business, agency, or similarly fast-moving environment

- Are exceptionally resourceful and good at figuring things out

- Think critically instead of waiting for detailed instructions

- Can bring structure to incomplete or ambiguous projects

- Communicate clearly in excellent written and spoken English

- Are comfortable switching between analytical, administrative, creative, and commercial work

- Understand both execution and process improvement

- Can prioritize effectively when several things need attention

- Follow through reliably and close open loops

- Are comfortable receiving direct feedback and revising your work

- Know when to act independently and when a decision should be escalated

- Care about confidentiality, accuracy, and professional judgment

- Want to grow with a company rather than remain in a narrowly defined role



Required Qualifications



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Professional experience in a startup, small business, agency, operations, project coordination, or related environment

- Strong research, problem-solving, and organizational abilities

- Confidence in learning unfamiliar software and processes

- Experience independently managing projects or recurring workflows

- Ability to document work clearly

- Reliable computer and internet connection

- Availability during [Needs to have some scheduling flexibility to coordinate with clients during US afternoons, and Team Leadership in US Eastern Time Evenings

]

Valuable but Not Required



Any of the following would be helpful:



- Operations or project-management experience

- Lead generation or outbound outreach

- Sales support, pipeline management, or CRM administration

- SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing

- AI tools, prompting, or workflow automation

- Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable, Notion, or similar platforms

- Basic software development, scripting, APIs, or technical troubleshooting

- Data analysis, dashboards, or reporting

- Healthcare, licensing, credentialing, compliance, or client-service experience

- Creating SOPs and training team members

- Recruiting, vendor management, or team coordination



We do not expect one candidate to have every bonus skill. Demonstrated intelligence, resourcefulness, ownership, and learning ability are more important than checking every box.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first several months, you should be able to:



- Learn our services and core licensing workflow

- Take ownership of recurring operational responsibilities

- Complete projects with progressively less supervision

- Create clear systems and documentation where none existed

- Identify problems before they become urgent

- Recommend improvements based on evidence

- Use technology to reduce repetitive work

- Communicate reliable updates without needing to be chased

- Contribute to both excellent client service and company growth



Growth Opportunity



This role is designed to expand.



A high performer may grow into responsibility for:



- Company operations

- Process design and automation

- Team coordination and quality assurance

- Lead-generation systems

- Sales operations

- New service development

- Hiring and training

- Operations management



Growth will depend on judgment, performance, ownership, and the company’s needs—not simply time in the role.



Position Details

- Location: Remote

- Schedule: [Full-time]

- Working hours: [Needs to have some scheduling flexibility to coordinate with clients during US afternoons and Team Leadership in US Eastern Time Evenings]

- Reporting to: Founder



How to Apply



To be considered, complete this assessment:

Assessment link: [
]



Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.



Your application must include:



1. Your résumé

2. A brief introduction written specifically for this role

3. Your assessment result or completion confirmation

4. Your expected monthly salary 

5. Your availability and preferred working hours

6. Links or descriptions of systems, automations, projects, or processes you have created

7. The phrase “Build the System” at the beginning of your application



Please answer these questions:

title: Retail Operations & Data Specialist

About the Role



We're looking for a highly detail-oriented and experienced Retail Operations & Data Specialist to take ownership of product data, retailer onboarding, documentation, ERP/EDI projects, and other operational requirements associated with selling into major retailers.



This is not an entry-level role. We're looking for someone who has worked within CPG, FMCG, food, or a similar product-based business and understands the level of accuracy required when working with large retailers, distributors, 3PLs, and supply chain partners. A CPG or consumer product background is essential — understanding the mindset and operational requirements of this type of product environment is important to us. You should be comfortable taking a project or operational requirement, understanding what needs to happen, gathering the necessary information, and driving it through to completion with minimal hand-holding.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time to start (approximately 20 hours per week), with strong potential to progress into a full-time role

Opportunity: Long-term position working with an international business operating across the US, Europe, and Asia

Compensation: (please confirm rate)



Key Responsibilities



1. Product Master Data Management



Manage and maintain accurate product master data including SKUs, UPCs/GTINs, barcodes, case configurations, dimensions, weights, ingredients, and other product specifications

Review product and packaging information for accuracy, including ingredient information and multilingual requirements

Maintain organized and accurate product information across internal databases, retailer portals, and operational documents

Maintain clear file structures, documentation, and internal systems so information can be easily accessed and updated



2. Retailer Onboarding & Account Administration



Complete retailer new vendor, new item, and product setup forms accurately and on time

Support onboarding and ongoing administration for major US and European retail accounts

Review retailer requirements and ensure all necessary operational documentation is completed correctly

Support the completion of retailer-specific compliance forms, portals, templates, and documentation



3. ERP & EDI Support



Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the company's ERP system

Assist with EDI setup and coordination, working with external EDI partners, retailers, and internal stakeholders

Prepare and organize the data required for ERP migration, integration, and system setup



4. Logistics & Supply Chain Documentation



Help manage product, logistics, and supply chain documentation for US import and 3PL operations

Coordinate information between suppliers, factories, 3PLs, retail partners, and internal stakeholders

Track and manage inbound documentation requirements to keep operations on schedule



5. Compliance & Risk Management



Identify missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information before it creates downstream issues

Proactively flag potential compliance, data, or operational issues that could lead to retailer delays, chargebacks, or penalties



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years in operations, retail operations, supply chain, or product data — CPG, FMCG, food, beverage, or confectionery experience is required; candidates without a CPG or consumer product background will not be the right fit for this role

Retail Knowledge: Experience supporting brands selling into major US retailers is highly advantageous; familiarity with retailer onboarding, item setup, vendor portals, and retailer documentation

ERP & EDI: Experience working with ERP systems and managing detailed product or inventory data; understanding of EDI and experience supporting EDI implementations is highly preferred

Tools: Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Communication: Strong written and spoken English; confident communicating with external vendors, retailers, logistics partners, and internal stakeholders

Profile: Exceptional attention to detail, naturally methodical, proactive problem solver — identifies what is missing rather than waiting to be told what to do; comfortable handling large quantities of product information without sacrificing accuracy



To Apply: 

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: Real Estate Media Operations & Quality Control Coordinator
description:
Elevare Creative is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Operations & Quality Control Coordinator to manage the post-production and delivery workflow for our real estate media.



This is not a photography position. Our photographers capture the properties, and most editing is handled through our editing systems and partners. Your responsibility is making sure every project is complete, polished, organized, and delivered to our clients at the highest standard.



You’ll be responsible for bringing together media from multiple platforms, checking everything for accuracy and quality, and making sure each client receives a complete final package on time.



If you enjoy creating organized workflows, catching small details others miss, and making sure everything is perfect before it reaches the client, this role is for you.



What You’ll Do



You’ll own the workflow from the moment a photographer uploads their media until the client receives their final delivery.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor incoming and active projects in Tonomo

* Verify photographers have uploaded all required files

* Perform quality control on all photos before delivery

* Make Photoshop edits when necessary, including removing distractions, straightening objects, fixing minor imperfections, replacing skies, and other retouching

* Organize, rename, and prepare final photo sets

* Maintain organized Dropbox folders and project files

* Retrieve completed media and assets from platforms such as Matterport, CubiCasa, and Zillow 3D Home

* Download and organize Matterport 3D Tour assets

* Retrieve CubiCasa floor plans and associated files

* Review and prepare Zillow 3D Home tours for delivery

* Build and complete Zillow Showcase listings through Aryeo, making sure all required media and listing assets are properly uploaded and organized

* Upload photos, videos, 3D tours, floor plans, and other media into Tonomo

* Verify every ordered service is completed before delivering a project

* Deliver completed projects to clients

* Handle client revision requests and make sure revisions are completed promptly

* Coordinate virtual staging orders and retrieve completed staged images

* Follow up with photographers or team members regarding missing files or incomplete projects

* Maintain delivery timelines and keep projects moving through the workflow

* Catch missing, incorrect, or low-quality media before it reaches the client

* Ensure every project meets Elevare Creative’s quality standards



Requirements



* Exceptional attention to detail

* Strong organizational and file-management skills

* Experience using Adobe Photoshop

* Experience using Adobe Lightroom

* Comfortable performing photo retouching and corrections when needed

* Experience organizing and managing files in Dropbox

* Strong written English and communication skills

* Reliable internet connection

* Comfortable working across multiple software platforms

* Comfortable learning new software and workflows quickly

* Able to follow detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once

* Comfortable taking ownership of projects and identifying issues without needing constant supervision



Experience with real estate media workflows is strongly preferred but not required if you are highly organized and willing to learn.



Software & Platforms



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Tonomo

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Lightroom

* Dropbox

* Matterport

* CubiCasa

* Zillow 3D Home

* Zillow Showcase

* Aryeo

* AutoHDR

* Virtual staging platforms

* Other real estate media delivery or project management software



Application Questions



1. Have you worked with real estate photography or real estate media before? Tell us about your experience.

2. How would you rate your Photoshop skills: Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced? What types of edits are you comfortable making?

3. Have you ever been responsible for quality control before delivering work to a client? Please explain your process.

4. Have you worked with Tonomo, Aryeo, Matterport, CubiCasa, Zillow 3D Home, Zillow Showcase, AutoHDR, Dropbox, or similar software? Please list the platforms you have experience with.

5. Have you ever been responsible for gathering files or deliverables from multiple platforms and organizing them into one final client delivery? Please explain.

6. How do you make sure nothing is missing when managing multiple projects at the same time?

7. What days and hours are you typically available each week?

8. Why do you think you’d be a good fit for this role?

title: Full-Time WordPress Developer & SEO Website Manager
description:
FULL-TIME WORDPRESS DEVELOPER & SEO WEBSITE MANAGER

Remote (Philippines-based) | Full-time | $500 USD/month



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word SAGE so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a multi-region women's health and fitness franchise (AU/NZ, Canada, US) looking for a full-time developer to own our WordPress website end-to-end — technical build work, security, SEO execution, and getting our blog/email content out the door. You'll work directly with, and be led by, our project lead in Sydney, who will give you clear written briefs, direction, and regular check-ins along the way. You won't be left to figure everything out on your own — this is a genuinely managed role with hands-on leadership.



What we're hoping for is someone who takes real ownership of the work they're given: delivers what was asked, tests it before calling it done, and flags problems early rather than going quiet — and who grows into more independence over time as they learn our systems. We don't expect you to arrive already running the whole website unsupervised.



This is a hands-on technical role, not a support/ticket role. You'll be trusted with real production systems from week one, with clear guidance every step of the way.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



WordPress Development & Site Management

- Customize and extend the site's theme (Sage/Blade framework) and flexible content fields (ACF Flexible Content / Gutenberg blocks) to build new page layouts and modules

- Maintain four regional site variants (AU, NZ, CA, US) via WPML

- Perform monthly core/theme/plugin maintenance with zero downtime

- Work in our GitHub repo — proper branches, pull requests, clear commit messages, staging deploys

- Manage WP Engine hosting (staging, deploys, backups)

- Handle API integrations — booking/scheduling platforms and GoHighLevel (GHL) automations



SEO & AI Search Visibility

- Execute on-page SEO: meta tags, header structure, image alt-text, schema/structured data (Yoast or RankMath)

- Apply AIO/AEO best practices — structuring content (FAQ/HowTo schema, answer-first formatting) so it gets picked up by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and similar AI search tools

- Evaluate and use SEO/keyword monitoring tools (e.g. SEMrush)



Content & Campaign Distribution

- Publish weekly blog posts provided by the content team — formatting, imagery, links, SEO/AIO structure (you won't be writing the copy)

- Build, test, and deploy Mailchimp email campaigns tied to blog content to drive traffic; manage segmentation and automated workflows



Security & Technical Health

- Manage Wordfence security, credential rotation, and secrets storage

- Run plugin audits and manage license decisions

- Proactively catch bugs, broken functionality, and site speed issues



Working with AI Tools

- Use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to speed up development — while still reviewing, understanding, and taking ownership of everything shipped

- Be ready to explain specifically how you've used AI tools on past projects, not just that you're aware of them



REQUIRED SKILLS



- 3+ years hands-on WordPress development (PHP, ACF — including Flexible Content field layouts — Gutenberg, a modern theme framework like Sage/Blade, Timber, or Roots)

- Solid Git/GitHub workflow — branching, PRs, resolving conflicts

- On-page SEO execution experience (Yoast/RankMath) and awareness of AI-search optimization trends (AIO/AEO/GEO)

- Experience with Mailchimp or a similar ESP for campaign building

- API integration experience

- Conversational English strong enough to follow Zoom calls and multi-step verbal instructions. You won't be writing marketing copy, so full fluency isn't required — but you do need to understand and be understood live. This is assessed as part of the process.

- Demonstrated experience using AI tools to speed up real development work (not just "I've heard of Copilot")

- Able to take a clear written brief and run with it, asking smart clarifying questions rather than guessing — you'll have ongoing leadership and direction, so this is about taking ownership of assigned work, not managing the whole website unsupervised



NICE-TO-HAVE



- Direct GoHighLevel experience (workflows, Communities, Courses/Memberships, Client Portal)

- Basic graphic skills in Canva or similar, for preparing blog images

- Google Analytics / Search Console experience

- Experience with Notion as a project management tool — all our documentation and project management runs through it, though this is easy to pick up if you haven't used it before



WORK STYLE WE NEED



- Full-time hours, but no fixed 9-5 required — you're welcome to structure your day however suits you, as long as your full-time hours are covered and you're available for scheduled meetings at reasonable times

- Takes a clear, written task and runs with it — you'll get direction and leadership, not silence, so this is about follow-through rather than figuring it all out alone

- Proactive communicator — flags blockers, asks sharp questions, reports back clearly rather than going quiet

- Willing to learn, adapt, and take on new challenges you're unfamiliar with — you won't know everything on day one, and that's expected



COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS



- $500 USD/month, full-time contractor role

- Fully remote

- Reports to: Project Lead (Sydney, Australia)



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with a message that starts with the word SAGE and includes LINKS to the following (Google Drive, Loom, or similar — make sure sharing is set to "anyone with the link"):



1. Your CV/resume

2. Portfolio or live site examples

3. Your GitHub profile

4. A short video (max 7 minutes) answering these prompts out loud:

   - Introduce yourself and your development background.

   - Walk us through a project you're proud of — what was your specific role?

   - Tell us about a time you got stuck on a technical problem. What did you do?



Please don't read from a script — you're welcome to think through your answers beforehand, but we want to hear you speak naturally, not recite something written. Applications missing the video or GitHub link will not be shortlisted.



We look forward to reviewing your appliaction and potentially welcoming you to the team.

title: Senior Media Buyer - Meta
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads, Affiliate Lead Generation) - Remote, Full-Time



We are looking for Senior Media Buyer to run Meta ad campaigns for affiliate lead-generation offers. 



This is a remote, full-time position.



You will be the person who takes a new offer, tests it, finds what works, and scales it. You report directly to the owner and work inside our own Business Manager, tracker, and creative pipeline.



This is NOT an e-commerce role. We do not sell products or run stores.



We generate leads and calls for affiliate offers in home services (bathroom remodeling, roofing, windows, solar, HVAC, and similar) and in the refinancing and mortgage space (cash-out refinance, home equity, debt consolidation).



If your Meta experience is only in e-commerce, dropshipping, or brand awareness, this role is NOT the right fit.



You must have hands-on experience as a Meta Ads Manager buyer for affiliate lead-generation offers. That means you have personally built campaigns, written the targeting, chosen the creatives, set the budgets, read the numbers every morning, and made the kill, keep, or scale decision yourself.



You know how a lead-gen funnel differs from a store checkout, and you know how to read a campaign when the payout comes from the network and not from the Meta pixel.



You must be able to show your testing and scaling methodology, not just describe it. In the interview you will walk us through how you approach a brand-new offer: how you structure the first launch, how many ad sets and creatives you start with, what daily budgets you use, what your kill rules are, and when you d
 an offer is worth scaling.



We expect you to know and be able to explain the Brazilian testing method, when you use CBO versus ABO, how you move a winner from testing into a scaling structure, and how you handle creative fatigue. If you have your own variations on these methods, even better, but you must be able to defend them with numbers from campaigns you have actually run.



You must have experience working with affiliate networks. You know how to read a network dashboard, how caps and payouts work, how to set up postbacks and sub IDs, how to talk to an affiliate manager, and how to tell the difference between a tracking problem and a bad campaign. Experience with a click tracker (RedTrack, Voluum, ClickFlare, or similar) is expected.



Your day-to-day responsibilities: launch and manage campaigns across multiple ad accounts and offers, monitor spend and lead quality daily, request and brief new creatives from our creative team, keep a clear record of every test and its result, protect the ad accounts by following Meta's policies and our internal rules, and report performance in plain numbers, not stories.



Reliability is a hard requirement.  You must attend a daily team meeting on video, camera on, Monday through Friday, at a time set with the team. You must be reachable during working hours and you must tell us before a problem becomes a surprise. Missed meetings and silent days are the fastest way to lose this position.



What we offer: a remote full-time role with a stable workload, offers with real budgets, a creative team producing new ads for you, our own tracking and automation tools, and direct access to the owner with no layers in between.



Compensation is p40000 per month.

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Content Repurposing Editor – TikTok & Instagram
description:
We are looking for a reliable and creative **Short-Form Video Editor** for a stable, long-term collaboration editing content for TikTok and Instagram Reels.



The editing itself is simple. We are NOT looking for complex motion graphics or heavy effects.



What matters most to us is your ability to look at raw footage and find different ways to turn it into multiple strong, usable videos.



### WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will receive vertical raw video recordings, usually around 5–6 minutes long.



Your job will be to turn this footage into short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels, generally ranging from approximately 20 seconds to a maximum of 2.5 minutes.



The footage will not contain spoken audio. Voice-over will be added separately after your edit.



Most edits will involve:



* Selecting and cutting footage

* Removing unnecessary sections

* Creating a natural, engaging pace

* Combining clips when appropriate

* Basic transitions

* Occasional zooms or simple effects

* Exporting final videos in 9:16 format, ready for TikTok and Instagram



No advanced motion graphics, subtitles or complex editing are required.



### THE MOST IMPORTANT PART



We are NOT looking for someone who simply waits for exact instructions about what to cut.



We want someone who can review the footage provided and identify different opportunities to create MORE usable content from it.



For example, you may receive several different raw recordings. If the introduction from one recording can naturally work with footage or the ending from another recording, we want you to recognize that opportunity and create an additional video.



One raw recording might produce one video. Another might produce two, three or more.



The goal is to get as much high-quality, usable content as reasonably possible from the footage provided, while making sure every final video feels natural and makes sense.



Creativity and initiative are very important for this role.



### WORKLOAD



Expected output is approximately **50–60 short-form videos per month**, depending on the footage available and the length of the final videos.



This will usually mean approximately **12–15 finished videos per week**.



Raw recordings are normally around 5–6 minutes long, and final videos will usually range from approximately 20 seconds to 2.5 minutes.



One revision round is included for each video.



Videos will be delivered weekly.



### WORKFLOW



We will work primarily through Google Drive.



You will receive:



* Raw footage to edit

* Clear initial guidelines

* TikTok accounts and videos showing the style, pacing and type of content we are looking for



You will be responsible for reviewing the footage, identifying different content opportunities, keeping files organized and delivering finished videos on time each week.



### WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* Experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts

* Experience with CapCut Desktop, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing software

* Strong sense of pacing and clean cuts

* Ability to repurpose and combine footage creatively

* Initiative and good judgment

* Attention to detail

* Good organization

* Reliable communication

* Ability to meet weekly deadlines

* Stable internet connection and a computer suitable for video editing



We are looking for someone who wants a **stable, long-term collaboration** and who can become increasingly independent once they understand the style of content we are creating.



### PAID TRIAL



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a small **paid editing test** before we choose the final editor.



You will receive raw footage and TikTok references showing the style we are looking for.



Rather than giving you exact instructions for every edit, we will ask you to create as many strong and usable short-form videos as you reasonably can from the footage provided.



You may combine clips from different recordings when appropriate, as long as the final video feels natural and coherent.



We want to evaluate not only your editing skills, but also your ability to identify content opportunities and make good editing decisions independently.



### HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. A link to your portfolio.

3. Three examples of TikToks, Reels or Shorts that you personally edited.

4. Which editing software you use.

5. How many hours per week you currently have available.

6. Briefly answer this question:



**If you receive three different 5-minute raw videos, how would you approach turning them into as many strong and usable pieces of content as possible?**



Please start your application with the words **PURPLE EDIT** so we know you have read the full job description.



Applications that do not include **PURPLE EDIT** or examples of short-form video editing will not be considered.



We are looking forward to finding the right person to work with us long term!

GOLD FOUND



so I know you read the instructions.

title: Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant
description:
Company: MNJ Trading

Location: Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Working hours: 8:00AM-12NN MANILA TIME



About MNJ Trading



MNJ Trading is an import and export company serving customers throughout the South Pacific region. Our customers operate primarily in the hospitality, industrial, and commercial sectors.



We help customers source suitable products, identify competitive suppliers, prepare quotations, coordinate orders, and arrange delivery to their destination.



About the Role



We are looking for a practical, organized, and detail-oriented Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant.



This is not a role based only on writing
s or speaking confidently. You will be expected to research products, compare suppliers, check specifications, calculate shipping volumes, prepare accurate quotations, follow up on orders, and keep information properly organized.



Our selection process includes a practical work assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the role.



Main Responsibilities:

- Research products based on customer requirements.

- Find and compare suitable suppliers.

- Verify product specifications, pricing, availability, MOQ, lead time, warranty, and delivery conditions.

- Request missing information from suppliers.

- Prepare supplier comparison sheets.

- Calculate carton quantities, weights, dimensions, CBM, and estimated shipping costs.

- Prepare accurate customer quotations.

- Coordinate orders with suppliers, warehouses, freight forwarders, and customers.

- Monitor order and shipment progress.

- Maintain organized records, spreadsheets, invoices, packing lists, and shipping documents.

- Identify missing or conflicting information before it becomes a problem.

- Provide clear updates to management and customers.

- Manage several requests according to urgency and commercial importance.



What Good Performance Looks Like



A successful team member:

- Checks details instead of making unsupported assumptions.

- Understands the difference between the lowest price and the best commercial option.

- Can identify when a product does not fully meet the customer’s requirements.

- Uses spreadsheet formulas correctly.

- Keeps source links, calculations, and records easy to verify.

- Communicates delays and problems early.

- Follows instructions and meets deadlines.

- Takes ownership of tasks through completion.

- Asks specific questions when information is missing.

- Produces accurate work without requiring constant supervision.



Required Skills

- Strong online product and supplier research skills.

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Ability to compare prices and commercial terms.

- Confidence working with quantities, dimensions, weights, and CBM.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Clear written English.

- Ability to organize files and information.

- Good judgment when handling incomplete or conflicting information.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently.



Experience in procurement, sourcing, logistics, import/export, hospitality supplies, industrial supplies, or quotation preparation is an advantage.



Application Process



The process consists of:

- Initial application review

- MNJ Trading Practical Work Assessment 

- A short interview and live work verification

- Reference checks, if applicable.



Generic cover letters will not receive additional points. We are more interested in clear evidence of how you work.



How to Apply



Please submit:

- Brief Introduction why you're best fit for this role

- One redacted example of a supplier comparison, quotation, logistics spreadsheet, or similar document you personally prepared.



Your answers to the questions below.

1. Describe one product you previously sourced. What information did you verify before recommending a supplier?

2. Tell us about a mistake or discrepancy you found in an invoice, quotation, order, or shipping document. What did you do?

3. If a supplier provides a low price but does not confirm the required specifications, how would you handle it?



Please use the subject line:

Application – Operations Assistant – [Your Full Name]



Applications that progress to the next stage will receive the practical assessment instructions.

Hi! I run online fashion and accessories shops selling on Depop.

I'm looking for one reliable person to post listings and handle customer messages.



This starts at around 12 hours a week — roughly 1.5 to 2 hours every day, 7 days a

week. Listings go out daily and customers message on weekends, so it's a short daily

shift rather than long weekday blocks.



Be aware this is a STARTING amount. The work scales quickly and I want to grow this

into full-time hours for the right person. I'm hiring for the long term, not a

short project.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Posting listings. This is the bulk of the job and where most of your time goes.

  The target is around 125 listings a day across several shops (about 25 per shop).

- Replying to customer messages. Only about 5 minutes per shop per day.

- A quick daily check that orders are moving as they should, and flagging anything

  that looks wrong.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- EXPERIENCE LISTING PRODUCTS on an online marketplace. This is a requirement, not

  a nice-to-have. eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Vinted, Shopify, Etsy, Depop — any of

  them is fine, but you need to have done volume listing before.

- Excellent WRITTEN English. You'll be writing to young customers, so it needs to

  sound natural and friendly, not formal or robotic.

- Good SPOKEN English — we'll talk regularly.

- A stable internet connection. You'll be working through a remote desktop, so a

  dropout means you can't work.

- Available every day, including weekends. The shift is short but it has to happen

  daily — listings not posted and messages left overnight cost me sales.

- Someone who asks when they're unsure instead of guessing. I would much rather

  answer a question than fix a mistake.



I'm completely fine with you having other clients or work alongside this, as long as

the daily shift happens. If you'd rather build up to full-time with me instead, that

option is there too.



WHAT I DON'T NEED

- Depop experience specifically. I'll train you and we have written procedures for

  everything.

- A team or an agency. I'm hiring one person directly.



THE SETUP

You'll work through a remote desktop that I provide. Everything is already logged

in, so you never have to handle passwords or accounts.



PAY

$5 USD/hour to start, paid weekly. Reviewed after the first month, and it goes up

with hours and responsibility.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word LANTERN so I know you read this properly.



Then tell me, briefly:

2. Your internet speed (screenshot from a speed test)

Shortlisted applicants get a short PAID test task (about 30 minutes, paid $5 USD)

before any interview — I pay for your time either way. After that there's a paid

settling-in period while I walk you through how everything works.

title: Bilingual Administration & Client Liaison Coordinator (Mandarin / English)
description:
Company is seeking a detail-oriented, culturally fluent Bilingual Administration & Client Liaison Coordinator to strengthen the administrative backbone of the business while opening a dedicated channel of communication with our growing base of Mandarin-speaking guests, inbound tour partners, and travel agents. This is a genuinely varied administrative role: the majority of your week will be spent on core office administration, records management, and booking/CRM support, with a meaningful portion dedicated to Mandarin-English guest liaison, translation of guest-facing materials, and coordination with Chinese-market travel trade contacts.



This role suits a candidate who is equally comfortable maintaining a tidy filing system and greeting a Mandarin-speaking guest with warmth and confidence — someone who takes pride in accuracy, communicates clearly across two languages and cultures, and is energised by variety rather than overwhelmed by it. Prior exposure to aviation, tourism, or inbound travel businesses is a strong advantage, as elements of this role (SA
 awareness, guest safety briefings, pilot logistics) are specific to the industry.



Key Duties & Responsibilities

1. General Administration & Records (~35% of role — Primary Focus)

● Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Associate Director and wider Company team, including correspondence, diary coordination, and document preparation.

● Maintain accurate filing, recordkeeping, and document control systems for flight operations, purchase orders, guest records, and pilot logistics.

● Prepare, format, and proofread internal documents, guest-facing letters, and reports in both English and Mandarin as required.

● Track office and operational supply inventory, ensuring stock levels are maintained and stockouts are avoided.

● Support routine updates to booking and workspace systems (Rezdy, Google Workspace) and report system bugs or IT issues promptly.

● Assist with onboarding administration for new pilots, contractors, and support staff as the team grows.



2. Mandarin-English Guest Liaison & Client Services (~30% of role — Secondary Focus)

● Serve as the primary Mandarin-English point of contact for Chinese-speaking guests, tour operators, and travel agents, via
, phone, and messaging platforms (e.g. WeChat).

● Respond to Mandarin-language enquiries regarding scenic flight and charter bookings with a warm, professional manner, and translate/relay enquiries to the wider team as needed.

● Translate and localise guest-facing materials — booking confirmations, pre-flight briefings, safety information, and marketing collateral — from English into accurate, culturally appropriate Mandarin, and vice versa.

● Deliver timely pre-flight and post-flight guest communication, setting clear expectations on timing, weather contingencies, and requirements, in the guest's preferred language.

● Act as an interpreter during live calls or virtual meetings between Company staff and Mandarin-speaking guests or partners when required.

● Flag recurring guest feedback, cultural considerations, or process issues to the Associate Director to support continuous improvement of the Chinese-market guest experience.



3. Bookings & CRM Coordination (~20% of role)

● Enter and update confirmed bookings in Rezdy promptly and accurately to keep the booking calendar current.

● Process booking amendments, rescheduling, and cancellations, updating all relevant systems and notifying affected guests and crew without delay.

● Maintain accurate guest and partner records in the CRM/booking system, including language preference and communication history.

● Support SARRMs (Search and Rescue) data entry and other flight-following administrative requirements to agreed timing standards.

● Coordinate pilot accommodation and car hire bookings as required for rostered trips.



4. Marketing, Content & Chinese-Market Coordination (~15% of role)

● Support translation and localisation of website content, blog posts, and social media captions for Mandarin-speaking audiences.

● Coordinate outreach and relationship-building with Chinese-market travel agents, inbound tour operators, and group booking contacts.

● Assist with social media scheduling and monitoring of Chinese-market-relevant platforms (e.g. WeChat, Xiaohongshu/RED) where applicable, in coordination with the marketing function.

● Support basic website updates, image uploads, and content coordination as required.



Language Requirements

● Native or near-native fluency in Mandarin Chinese (spoken and written), and professional fluency in English (spoken and written) — essential.

● Demonstrated ability to translate and interpret accurately between Mandarin and English in a business context, including under time pressure (e.g. live guest calls).

● Cantonese proficiency is an advantage but not required.



Required Experience

● Minimum 2 years' experience in an administrative, client services, or coordination role where accuracy and meeting deadlines were critical.

● Demonstrated experience communicating professionally with Mandarin-speaking clients, guests, or partners in a business setting.

● Demonstrated ability to work effectively and independently in a remote/offshore capacity, supporting an Australian-based team.

● A proven track record of delivering excellent, professional customer service across
, phone, and messaging channels.

● Fast, accurate data entry skills with strong attention to detail.

● Experience managing and responding to enquiries across multiple channels and, where possible, multiple languages.



Nice to Have

● Previous experience in tourism, travel, inbound Chinese-market tourism, or the aviation industry.

● Experience with a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) or booking system such as Rezdy.

● Experience with content translation, localisation, or social media scheduling tools.

● Familiarity with WeChat, Xiaohongshu (RED), or other Chinese-market digital platforms used for guest communication or marketing.



Required Education

● Bachelor's degree required.

● Formal qualification or certification in translation/interpretation, business administration, or a related field highly desirable.



Required Traits

● Proactive & Self-Motivated: The capacity to manage a diverse workload independently, anticipate needs, and take initiative without constant supervision.

● Culturally Fluent Communicator: Able to move naturally between English and Mandarin business communication styles, representing Company professionally to guests and partners from both cultures.

● Highly Detail-Oriented & Accurate: The ability to notice and correct small errors in data, translations, and documentation, and maintain consistently high accuracy.

● Excellent Written & Verbal Communication: A professional, friendly phone and messaging manner and the ability to compose clear, concise, guest-ready correspondence in both languages.

● Efficient & Organised: A proven ability to manage time effectively, prioritise competing tasks, and meet deadlines consistently.

● Problem-Solver: A natural inclination to troubleshoot issues and find practical, effective solutions, including navigating cross-cultural misunderstandings.



Required Software & Systems

● Google Workspace

● General booking/CRM software (training provided on Rezdy if not already familiar)

● High level of general computer literacy



Nice to Have Software & Systems

● Rezdy

● Xero (basic familiarity, for cross-coverage of finance-admin tasks)

● Social media scheduling tools (e.g. Social Bee) and Chinese-market platforms (WeChat Official Account backend, Xiaohongshu)

title: Short-Form Editor / Graphic Designer **Rockstars Only**
description:
Are you an A player? We want you on our team!



Here's the wrong version of this role: someone who logs on, asks what they should work on, sends three "just checking if this looks right?" messages, and waits. We already know what needs to be made. We wrote it down. If the brief and the brand bible are sitting in your queue and you still need a call to start, this isn't a fit.



Here's the right version: you pull a task, read the brief once, look at the last three approved assets for that client, and build something that looks like it belongs next to them. You submit it. It's right the first time more often than it isn't. When something is genuinely ambiguous, you ask specific questions in one message and keep working on something else while you wait.



What you'll make



Short-form video (Reels, TikToks, paid ad cuts) and the static side of it: carousels, feed graphics, flyers, ad creative. Real small businesses with real ad spend behind some of it. Multiple clients, multiple brand voices, switched between in the same afternoon.



Tools you should already be fluent in



CapCut and DaVinci Resolve or equivalent for video. Photoshop and the Adobe suite or equivalent for design. Canva for anything going into a client's hands. We won't train you on these. We will absolutely train you on our clients.



How this works



You're online during a set daily window so revisions and the occasional rush don't sit overnight. Inside that window, nobody hovers. There's no no hour-by-hour reporting. What we measure is whether assets land on time, in the naming convention, at the right quality, and how fast you respond when a revision comes in.



The rules that aren't negotiable: brand bible before you start, naming convention on every file, new version every time (never overwrite), and when you're blocked you say so immediately instead of quietly stalling. Two people review your work and both will tell you plainly when something misses.



Who we're looking for



We're a growing agency, and we're building the team that takes us to the next stage. Your work is seen by the people who d
 things, on the day you do it.



We're hiring for a seat, not a project. We'd rather train one person properly over several years than churn through six editors in one. So we care less about whether you know every shortcut in Resolve today and more about whether you'll know them in six months because you went and learned them on your own. As we grow, the people who grew with us get first claim on what comes next.



What we're actually looking for in a person:



You tell the truth about your work. If you missed a deadline, you say so before we find out. If you didn't understand the brief, you say that too, instead of guessing and hoping. We've never once been upset with someone for saying "I don't know how to do this yet." We have been upset with silence.



You communicate without being chased. A short message that says what's done, what's stuck, and what you need is worth more to us than an hour of perfect work we didn't know was happening. Going quiet is the single fastest way to lose this job.



You get better on purpose. You watch how other editors cut, you notice when a style is shifting, you bring an idea occasionally instead of only executing. Nobody here will build you a curriculum. The people who do well are the ones who improve because they wanted to.



You move without being pushed. When the queue is empty you say so instead of waiting to be found. When something is obviously broken you flag it. When you finish early you ask what's next. That instinct is most of what we mean by independent, and you either have it or you don't.



You take criticism as information. Your work gets reviewed, and you'll be told plainly when something misses. It's not personal and it isn't a comment on you. Editors who take feedback as an insult burn out fast. Editors who take it as data get very good, very quickly.



What we'll give back:



Honest feedback, consistent and on-time pay, clear briefs, and real autonomy inside your shift. We won't message you after hours. We won't ask you to pretend to be busy. And if you're good, we'll keep you for years and grow the role around you. We care about all members of our team and want to see you grow and succeed in life.



If this sounds like a fit for you - Send over your portfolio for a chance to enter the trial task phase

title: Creator Outreach Specialist - Message, Follow Up and Book Calls
description:
VIXA is a new AI dating clarity app for women. We are building our creator program from the ground up and need a Creator Outreach Specialist to help us grow it.



What you will do:

- Send personalized opening messages to verified content creators (no copy paste templates, every message needs at least 1 specific detail about that creator)

- Run the follow up sequence until you get a reply

- Book calls with creators who are interested

- Get creators to join our 
 server and stay active there

- Help creators finish their first paid trial video



How to message creators (this is how we expect every message to look):

1. Mention 1 real detail about that creator. Example: a recent video they posted, their niche, or their follower count. No generic compliments.

2. State 1 clear offer in a single sentence. Example: "$1 per 1,000 views, up to $1,000 per video."

3. End with 1 clear next step. Example: "Want me to send you the details and a link to join?" Never end with a vague line like "let me know."

4. Add 1 line of proof. Example: "VIXA is a real app, live in the App Store."

5. Keep it short. A few sentences, not a long paragraph. 1 link maximum.

6. If they do not reply in 48 to 72 hours, send 1 short follow up. If still no reply after that, send 1 final short message and move on.

7. Never sound desperate or pushy. Sound like a professional offering a real paid opportunity.



You can use Claude AI or ChatGPT to help you draft your messages, but every message must still be personalized and unique.



Pay:

- $5.00 to $8.00 per hour to start

- $2.00 to $3.00 bonus for every creator who replies

- $5.00 to $10.00 bonus for every creator who joins our 
 server

- $15.00 to $25.00 bonus for every creator who finishes their first paid trial video

- Once you get 5 or more creators through the full process, your hourly rate goes up to $10.00 or more



Hours: 10 hours per week to start, moving up to 20 to 25 hours per week for strong performers. Goal: reach out to 20 to 30 new creators every week.



How we treat the people who work with us: on time pay, clear standards, early feedback, and a raise as you prove yourself.



To apply: put the word VELA somewhere in your application so we know you read this whole post. We also want a short video, 2 to 3 minutes, where you role play the first few minutes of a message conversation with a creator (not a self introduction).



Looking for: strong English, a warm and inviting personality, and experience with social media, influencer marketing, lead generation, or virtual assistance.

title: Long-Term Online Early Childhood Educator / Homeschool Learning Guide
description:
Long-Term Online Early Childhood Educator / Homeschool Learning Guide



Remote / Online — Part-Time — Long-Term

Child: 4 years old

Family: Queensland, Australia (2 hours ahead of the Philippines)



We are looking for a warm, creative educator to work one-on-one online with our 4-year-old son and ideally become a consistent part of his education for several years.



This is not a standard tutoring role based around worksheets or delivering the same prepared lessons to every child. We want someone who gets to know him, follows his interests, plans specifically for him, and gradually helps guide a broad education as he grows.



About him

------------------



He is now 4, at home most of the time, and has not had formal preschool education.



He speaks reasonably well once engaged and loves being read to, including longer 20-minute stories. Recent favourites include Richard Scarry, Hairy Maclary and Dr. Seuss.



His strongest interests currently include:



* cars, tow trucks and vehicle recoveries

* building and construction

* seeing how things work

* watching people make and repair things



We would like to use these interests as gateways into broader learning.



For example, a tow-truck recovery might lead into reading, counting, drawing, storytelling, maps, simple physics, history, building something, problem solving, or discussing how the people involved might think and feel.



Education

------------------



Our immediate formal priority is learning to read. He is just beginning and does not yet know all his letters.



We would particularly value experience with early literacy, including letter sounds, phonemic awareness, systematic phonics, blending, early spelling, writing and reading.



Importantly, he already loves books. We want to build on that rather than turn reading into endless flashcards and worksheets.



Over time, we want a broad education covering areas such as:



* reading, writing and communication

* biology, health and understanding his body

* understanding emotions, his mind and basic psychology

* problem solving and reasoning

* creativity, art and making things

* engineering and building

* practical life skills and independence

* general knowledge

* mathematics

* science, including basic physics

* geography and, increasingly as he gets older, basic history



History at this age would mostly follow his interests — for example, how early cars such as the Ford Model T were built and how cars, engines, factories and roads changed over time. Like most topics, they should follow his interests and weave in the fundamentals through those.



Just as importantly, we want to develop curiosity, problem solving, creativity, emotional resilience, persistence, flexible thinking, communication, independence, observation, spatial reasoning and confidence with mistakes.



Learning style

------------------



We are interested in Montessori, Reggio Emilia, play-based, project-based and child-led learning, without needing to follow any philosophy rigidly.



Although lessons are online, we want learning to happen in the physical world as much as possible.



You might both draw, paint, cut and glue, build with cardboard or blocks, use toy cars, make maps, count objects, conduct simple experiments or work through a construction problem together.



We can prepare materials at home and, where useful, buy duplicate materials so you can both work on the same project over video.



Books and educational materials will have a separate family-funded budget, with flexibility for worthwhile resources and projects.



Emotional development

------------------



Emotional development and life skills are important parts of the role.



He can become frustrated when something is difficult or doesn’t work as expected. We want someone who can remain calm and connected, help him understand what he is feeling, work through problems, tolerate mistakes and gradually develop persistence and emotional regulation.



We value co-regulation and guidance rather than shame, punishment or forced compliance. This is not a therapy role; we simply want emotional skills integrated naturally into his education.



Filipino languages

------------------



Our son is half Filipino but has not yet learned that side of his languages.



English and general education are the priorities now, but over time we may introduce Cebuano/Bisaya and possibly Tagalog through conversation, stories and everyday activities.



These languages are a bonus, not a requirement.



Schedule

------------------



We expect to start with approximately:



* 30 minutes of direct learning each weekday

* 5 days per week

* additional paid planning and preparation time



This will depend on his attention and comfort and is intended as a starting point.



As he develops a relationship with the educator, we can see this gradually increasing toward 1–2 hours of learning per day, divided into shorter sessions rather than one long class. It may increase further as he gets older.



Initially, we anticipate approximately 10 paid hours per week in total, including teaching, planning and preparation.



Planning might include designing activities around his interests, preparing materials, planning literacy development, recommending books, keeping simple progress notes and adapting future lessons.



Long-term

------------------



We are looking for someone willing to commit for at least one year and ideally several years.



As he grows, the position could gradually develop from early-childhood education into broader homeschool education, with increased hours.



Continuity matters to us. We would rather find one excellent educator who knows him well than continually change tutors.



Who we’re looking for



Relevant experience may include:



* early-childhood / preschool / kindergarten education

* elementary education

* early literacy or systematic phonics

* Montessori or Reggio Emilia

* play-based or project-based education

* homeschooling

* child development



Formal qualifications are useful but not mandatory.



More important is someone who genuinely enjoys young children, speaks excellent English, is warm and patient, listens to the child, follows his interests, can improvise, asks interesting questions, encourages curiosity, and can design engaging activities rather than relying heavily on worksheets.



You should also be comfortable with the reality that a 4-year-old will not always sit still or follow the planned activity.



Compensation

------------------



Please tell us your preferred hourly or monthly rate.



All agreed teaching, planning and preparation time is paid.



Books and learning materials are funded separately.







How to apply

------------------



Please do not send only a generic résumé. We want to learn a little about you without making the application unnecessarily time-consuming.



1. Brief introduction



Please tell us:



* where in the Philippines you are based

* your religion

* relevant education/training

* experience with children aged approximately 3–6

* experience teaching early reading

* any Montessori, Reggio Emilia or play-based experience

* whether you speak Cebuano/Bisaya or Tagalog

* normal availability in Philippine time

* expected hourly or monthly compensation



2. Short video — 1–5 minutes



Please record a simple video speaking directly to our son as though you were meeting him for the first time.



He loves cars, tow trucks, building things and stories.



You might introduce yourself, show or tell him something interesting, or mention something you would enjoy reading, building or discovering together.



We are not evaluating appearance or video quality. We simply want to see your natural spoken English, warmth and way of engaging with a young child.



3. Mini lesson challenge



Imagine he is currently fascinated by tow trucks and vehicle recoveries.



What would you do with him for a 20–30 minute session?



It could involve reading, letters, maths, science, art, building, storytelling, history or anything else.



We aren’t looking for a formal lesson plan. We want to see how you turn something a child loves into learning.



4. Frustration scenario



You and he are making a cardboard vehicle together. It repeatedly falls apart.



He becomes frustrated, pushes it away and says:



“I can’t do it!”



What would you do next?



5. Long-term



Imagine you continue working with him from age 4 until age 6 or 7.



How would you hope his education — and your role in it — develops over those years?



Selection



We will shortlist applicants based on the overall application, particularly:



* how engaging you are with our son

* creativity and educational thinking

* approach to emotions and frustration

* natural communication with a young child

* long-term fit

* experience and knowledge

title: Bookkeeping, Billing & Accounts Receivable Coordinator
description:
About the Position



American Debate | Agape Consulting Group is a U.S.-based education organization that works with schools and school districts.



We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and professional Bookkeeping, Billing & Accounts Receivable Coordinator to help manage our financial records and the administrative process related to school and district payments.



This is not simply a data-entry position.



You will be responsible for keeping our financial records organized, tracking Work Orders (WO), Purchase Orders (PO), invoices and payments, and communicating professionally with school principals, secretaries, purchasing departments, and accounts-payable departments.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of tasks and follows through until they are completed.



Your Main Responsibilities



1. QuickBooks Online & Bookkeeping



You will:



Maintain our QuickBooks Online records

Categorize income and expenses

Record and match transactions

Reconcile bank accounts

Reconcile credit-card accounts

Maintain Accounts Receivable (A/R)

Maintain Accounts Payable (A/P)

Match payments to invoices

Identify missing, duplicate, or incorrect transactions

Keep financial records organized for our accountant/CPA

Prepare basic monthly reports, including P&L, Balance Sheet, and A/R Aging



2. Work Orders (WO) & Purchase Orders (PO)



You will maintain an Excel/Google Sheets master tracking system for our school and district work.



For each school, you will track information such as:



School/district

Principal/contact person

Contract or approved amount

WO number

PO number

Services completed

Invoice number

Invoice amount

Invoice submission date

Payment status

Amount received

Outstanding balance

Follow-up date

Notes/next action



If a WO, PO, or other required information is missing, you will identify the problem and contact the appropriate school representative to obtain it.



3. Invoicing & Accounts Receivable



You will:



Prepare accurate invoices

Verify WO/PO information before invoicing

Send or upload invoices

Maintain proof that invoices were submitted

Track outstanding invoices

Follow up on unpaid invoices

Investigate payment delays

Record payments received

Update QuickBooks and our tracking spreadsheet

Maintain an accurate list of money still owed to the company



We should always be able to ask you:



“Who owes us money, how much do they owe, and what is the next step?”



You should be able to answer accurately.



4. Professional
 Correspondence



A major part of this position involves communicating directly with U.S. schools.



You may need to
:



Principals

Assistant principals

School secretaries

District administrators

Purchasing departments

Accounts-payable departments



Examples include requesting a missing WO or PO number, confirming billing information, sending an invoice, requesting documentation, checking the status of an outstanding payment, or following up when someone has not responded.



Excellent written English and professional communication are extremely important.



What We're Looking For



You should have:



Professional bookkeeping experience

Strong QuickBooks Online experience

Experience with U.S. businesses preferred

Accounts Receivable experience

Accounts Payable experience

Invoice preparation experience

Bank and credit-card reconciliation experience

Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Excellent written English

Strong attention to detail

Excellent organizational skills

Confidence communicating professionally by

Ability to work independently

Strong follow-through



QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification is preferred but not required.



Experience working with schools, government agencies, nonprofits, professional-service businesses, or organizations using Work Orders/Purchase Orders is a plus.



Hours



Approximately 20 hours per week to start.



This is intended to be a long-term position. Hours may increase depending on workload and performance.



Some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours will be necessary for communication with our team and schools.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



Begin your application with the exact words:



“BETTER THINKERS, SPEAKERS & LEADERS”



Then answer the following.



TASK 1 — Professional



A principal has agreed to work with us, but we cannot submit an invoice because we have not received the school's Work Order or Purchase Order number.



Write the actual
 you would send to the principal or school secretary requesting the missing information.



TASK 2 — Accounts Receivable



You review our spreadsheet and find:



School A: $8,000 invoice submitted 10 days ago — unpaid

School B: $12,000 invoice submitted 75 days ago — unpaid

School C: $10,000 invoice submitted 40 days ago — $6,000 received

School D: $5,000 of work completed — WO received — invoice has not been created

School E: $7,500 approved — PO number is still missing



Tell us what you would do for each school and which items you would address first.



TASK 3 — Spreadsheet Organization



Using the five schools above, tell us what columns you would create in an Excel or Google Sheets master tracker.



We are interested in seeing how you organize information.



TASK 4 — QuickBooks



Please answer:



How many years have you used QuickBooks Online?

Are you QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certified?

Have you worked with U.S. businesses?

Have you reconciled bank accounts?

Have you reconciled credit cards?

Have you managed A/R?

Have you managed A/P?

Have you created and tracked invoices?

What QuickBooks reports are you comfortable preparing?

TASK 5 — Tell Us About Yourself



Please provide:



Your location in the Philippines

Years of bookkeeping experience

Most recent position

Reason you are leaving/left that position

Number of hours available each week

Your normal working hours in Philippine Time

Availability to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

Your desired hourly rate in USD

Whether you currently work for other clients

Whether this would be your primary job



Finally, in 100 words or less, tell us why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.

title: Property Accountant--AppFolio
description:
# Property Accountant — AppFolio | Full-Time, Remote | US$1,200–$1,600/Month



**Location:** Philippines — work from home

**Hours:** 40 hours per week

**Schedule:** Four hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours; remaining hours on an agreed schedule

**Compensation:** US$1,200–$1,600 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills



## About Amped Kitchens



Amped Kitchens builds, owns, and operates commercial kitchen buildings in Los Angeles and Chicago. Our clients include packaged-food brands (including several Filipino-owned brands), restaurant groups, and meal subscription companies that rely on us for the space and infrastructure to produce at scale.



We operate three properties and several related entities. We value accurate work, clear communication, follow-through, and people who spot and fix problems .



Learn more at 
.



## About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced Property Accountant with strong, hands-on AppFolio skills to manage daily accounting, maintain accurate financial records, and prepare monthly closes under our CFO’s supervision.



You will work closely with our onsite Tenant Coordinators, who handle client administration, invoice intake, and move-in/move-out coordination. Your responsibility is to keep the accounting accurate, resolve discrepancies, and make sure financial tasks reach completion.



You should be comfortable investigating an unfamiliar balance, questioning an unsupported transaction, and following up for missing information. We want someone who helps catch and prevent problems.



Our current workload includes fewer than 1,000 transactions and up to 250 vendor bills per month, with up to 10 bank and credit card accounts.



## What You’ll Do



**Accounts payable and payments**



* Review and process bills in AppFolio, confirming the correct entity, property, account, accounting period, supporting documents, and approvals.

* Handle shared expenses and allocations across entities and properties.

* Identify duplicate invoices, reconcile vendor statements and credits, and resolve discrepancies.

* Prepare scheduled payment runs for approval and process authorized payments.

* Track overdue or blocked invoices and give the team reliable information about payment status.



**Client billing and accounts receivable**



* Review recurring charges for completeness and accuracy, including rent, utilities, Facility Cost, storage, parking, escalations, and approved concessions.

* Work with Tenant Coordinators to resolve billing errors and discrepancies between AppFolio records and approved lease terms.

* Review payment applications and resolve unapplied, returned, or incorrectly posted receipts.

* Maintain accurate AR aging, reconcile receivables to the general ledger, and coordinate collection follow-up with Tenant Coordinators.

* Maintain accurate security-deposit accounting and process authorized refunds using the Tenant Coordinator’s completed disposition.



**Monthly close and financial reporting**



* Maintain accrual-basis accounting records in AppFolio.

* Reconcile bank, credit card, balance sheet, and intercompany accounts.

* Prepare accruals, adjusting entries, and supporting schedules for prepaid expenses, loans, fixed assets, capital improvements, and other assigned accounts.

* Prepare monthly financial statements and explain significant changes or budget variances.

* Prepare the monthly close package for CFO review by the 10th calendar day, following an agreed close calendar.

* Request missing information promptly and flag issues that could affect reporting accuracy or deadlines.

* Prepare supporting information for the outside CPA, year-end reporting, and lender requests.



**Payroll accounting and cash monitoring**



* Record and reconcile payroll processed through ADP, including allocations across entities and properties.

* Monitor cash balances and upcoming payment obligations.

* Flag funding needs early and prepare proposed intercompany transfers for approval.



**Communication and process improvement**



* Resolve accounting questions from Tenant Coordinators, clients, and vendors, keeping the appropriate team members informed.

* Maintain clear supporting records and notes in AppFolio.

* Document recurring accounting procedures and help improve inefficient or unclear workflows.

* Identify recurring errors and help the team prevent them.



## What We’re Looking For



* At least three years of relevant accounting experience, including responsibility for monthly closes.

* **Direct AppFolio accounting experience is required**, including reconciliations, tenant ledgers, AP/AR, and journal entries.

* Experience supporting U.S. property accounting; commercial real estate experience is strongly preferred.

* Strong understanding of accrual accounting and multi-entity/intercompany transactions.

* Strong Excel skills for reconciliations, allocations, and analysis.

* Clear written and spoken English, including the ability to explain an accounting issue to someone outside Accounting.

* Reliable follow-through, sound judgment, and willingness to ask questions when something does not look right.

* Reliable internet, a suitable workspace, and a practical backup plan for connectivity or power interruptions.



An accounting degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred. CPA credentials and ADP experience are helpful but not required.



## Working Schedule



You will work 40 hours per week, with four consistent hours each business day overlapping with **9 a.m.–5 p.m. U.S. Pacific Time, Monday–Friday**. We will agree on the exact overlap and remaining working hours before you start.



For example, a 1–5 p.m. Pacific overlap corresponds to:



* **4–8 a.m. Philippine time, Tuesday–Saturday**, during U.S. daylight saving time.

* **5–9 a.m. Philippine time, Tuesday–Saturday**, during U.S. standard time.



## What You Can Expect



* A long-term, full-time remote role supporting one operating business.

* Direct access to the CFO for accounting guidance and review.

* Collaboration with onsite teams who provide operational information and support.

* Flexibility outside the agreed overlap hours.

* Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to improve how the accounting function works.



## How to Apply



Please apply through this posting with your résumé and brief answers to these questions:



1. How long have you used AppFolio, and which accounting tasks have you personally performed?

2. Which parts of month-end close have you owned, and who reviewed your work?

3. Describe an accounting error you discovered. How did you investigate and resolve it?

4. What four-hour Pacific overlap can you consistently work, when could you start, and what compensation are you seeking within the posted range?



Shortlisted candidates will complete an interview and a short, paid accounting exercise using fictional records. We will request professional references from finalists.
